10000.card_text:
The Hollow Investigative Association has been studying Tyrfing's behavioral patterns, and research results show that its seemingly unbalanced stance of swaying and skewing is, in fact, a highly efficient stance for launching successive slashing attacks.
Due to its frequent appearances and aggressive behavior, Tyrfing has been identified as one of the most deadly Ethereals in the Hollow, particularly for certain Hollow personnel.
When faced with a shielded enemy, it relentlessly launches attacks until either its enemy or itself is destroyed.
"Perhaps... they don't actually hate us, but just think of us as punching bags for practice?"
10000.card_quote: —Midnight talk show "Back 2 Life," Episode 165, featuring retired riot patrol officer due to injury, Nobby Kereyan
10000.skill_text: During combat, Tyrfing will perform melee attacks.

10001.card_text:
The Hollow Investigative Association has limited research on Alpeca. After briefly studying its behavioral pattern of spewing liquid Ether, the Association classified Alpeca as a low-threat Ethereal and ended its investigation.
Scholars once showed great interest in observing how Alpeca spews liquefied Ether and even commissioned surveys for closer observation.
Experienced investigators have been avoiding such tasks for unknown reasons, however.
"Run! They're spitting again... Oh, no! My new clothes!"
10001.card_quote: —Deep within a Hollow, rookie investigator Raffaele Bert attempting to retreat
10001.skill_text: During combat, Alpeca will perform scattered ranged attacks.

10002.card_text:
A living humanoid Ether that was first spotted in the Hollow in the New Eridu metro. It once raised debate among the Hollow Investigative Association, as some believed it to be living Ether converted from the Corrupted, while others claimed it to be pure living Ether affected by the Hollow environment. The Association considers it of low threat due to its limited intelligence, but one should never underestimate them, as they usually appear in groups.
"Have you ever been late or fined because of a red light? Feels terrible, right?"
"Well, here's your chance to blow off some steam!"
10002.card_quote: —"Planet of Disaster" forum, comment from user "Waitin4BangbooPricetoDrop"
10002.skill_text: During combat, Faun tends to perform charged heavy attacks that are hard to interrupt.

10003.card_text:
While categorized by the Hollow Investigative Association as a "low threat" Ethereal, Hoplitai prove to be a formidable opponent for novice Hollow Raiders and investigators.
Its forelimbs are covered in a thick inert Ether matter, serving as both a tough shield and an intimidating weapon.
The only drawback is its top-heavy appearance, making it not look very clever.
"Alright, guys... Check out this sorry excuse... This is Hoplitai."
"When Ethereals gather together to play rock-paper-scissors, this idiot always plays paper!"
10003.skill_text: During combat, Hoplitai uses a shielded arms charge at opponents and block attacks.

10004.card_text:
According to research reports conducted by the Hollow Investigative Association, Blastcrawlers, with their low mobility and causing only small explosions, are classified as a "low-threat," "non-concern" lower-tier Ethereal.
However, astute businessmen have recognized the opportunities presented by their rounded bodies and short legs.
A film titled "Roll Over, Little Blastcrawler" gained significant popularity, leading to the sale of merchandise like Blastcrawler dolls and pillows at remarkably high prices.
"I didn't expect their dolls to be more deadly than the real deal... On your wallet at least. Looks like I'll be surviving on instant noodles next month, Billy..."
10004.card_quote: —Anby checking her wallet in front of the shopping street crane machine.

10014.card_text:
Mandrake derive their name from a toxic herb. The scholar who initially assigned the name believed there was a resemblance between the two solely based on their appearance.
While blooming, Mandrake emit heat rays targeting nearby objects, while sturdy leaves anchor it firmly to the ground, preventing uprooting. When threatened, Mandrake may use their sharp leaves for self-defense.
Similar to the legend of their namesake, Mandrake cries can be highly deadly.
"Stay away! It's gonna bloom any second now!"
10014.card_quote: —Mandrake blooming in the movie Deep Fear
10014.skill_text: During combat, different Mandrakes provide periodic ATK/Shield buffs to adjacent units.

10025.card_text:
Due to its unique and grotesque shape, Ahriman is often mistaken for an art sculpture in the Ballet Twins.
As a result, many novice investigators are left with lifelong trauma when they first encounter an Ahriman...
You just passed by a certain "sculpture" when it suddenly moves...
And that fearful moment frozen in place is the perfect moment for Ahriman to launch a surprise attack.
"Corin, don't be fooled by how it looks... It's no fancy art."
"Now, let's clean it up."
10025.card_quote: — Lycaon instructing Corin to clean up
10025.skill_text: During combat, Ahriman unleashes teleporting assaults and sometimes even teams up with another Ahriman to launch coordinated attacks.

10026.card_text:
Influenced by the distinctive decor of the interior of the Ballet Twins, Specters have the grotesque and twisted limb configuration of an artistic sculpture.
Some investigators believe its unique shape is intended to enhance the protection of its Ether Core.
Others argue it's merely a trick designed to distract its enemies. While its enemies are mesmerized by its peculiar posture, a Specter will seize the opportunity to launch long-range attacks using concentrated Ether.
"I looked at its bizarre structure and thought to myself: Was it trying to play a game of bowling with its own head?"
"But before I could make sense of anything, its bowling ball had already smashed into my face..."
10026.card_quote: —Posted by an anonymous user on Inter-Knot
10026.skill_text: During combat, Specter unleashes a burst of ranged attacks in quick succession.

10029.card_text:
While a Beholder Engine is primarily considered a close-range threat, it frequently presents unforeseen dangers to investigators during Hollow expeditions.
Even seasoned investigators can experience an overwhelming sense of panic when confronted by the piercing gaze of its eyes in the darkness.
Within the Hollows, fear has a tendency to intensify Ether corruption, thereby inviting calamity.
"The only way to overcome fear... is to stare into it and fight it back."
10029.card_quote: —Compilation of Knowledge from a Senior Investigator on the Planet of Disaster forum
10029.skill_text: During combat, Beholder Engine moves around by rolling its unique body.

10030.card_text:
Recent studies by the Whitestar Institute reveal that some Ethereals' limbs carry notable features from their environment.
Fossor is a prime example of this — its strange forelimbs bear a striking resemblance to the drilling equipment found in the Old Oil Field region.
Although some suggest this is a camouflage tactic to deceive enemies, others have pointed out that Fossor's combat style is aggressive and direct, making it appear ill-suited for ambushes.
Some imaginative Hollow Raiders speculate it may have developed this form just to dig for minerals...
"When I caught sight of it from a distance, it seemed to be happily digging up the asphalt."
"When it spotted me, it didn't hesitate to charge straight at me, desperately trying to drive me away..."
"But I was just passing by! I had absolutely no intention of taking any of its junk!"
10030.card_quote: — A rookie Hollow Raider outside a Hollow, recounting his recent experience to his companions
10030.skill_text: During combat, Fossor performs consecutive double-handed slashes.

10031.card_text:
The Hollows of the Outer Ring are home to a variety of bizarre Ethereals, and Sordidus is a prime example.
They possess a unique body structure, with highly flexible limbs that seem to be the result of an unknown reaction between crude oil and active Ether.
Once they lock onto a target, they use their limbs like expert acrobats, launching aggressive and brutal attacks.
"Damn it... That thing actually whipped me!"
"Does it see itself as a tamer, treating us like wild beasts?"
10031.card_quote: — Inside the Hollow, a group of rookie Hollow Raiders battling a Sordidus
10031.skill_text: During combat, Sordidus will whip with its tentacles for close-range attacks or insert its tentacles into the ground for long-range surprise attacks.

20000.card_text:
Farbauti, possessing immense strength and often in a frenzied state, is one of the most formidable threats Hollow Raiders may face. Its hammer-like arms can effortlessly deflect damage and unleash storms of blows that crush everything in its path.
Some Hollow Raiders have observed Farbauti frequently pounding the ground in a rhythmic, high-frequency manner, leading to speculation about its peculiar interest in drumming music.
Despite the Hollow Investigative Association publicly debunking this rumor, many Hollow Raiders carry portable stereos in an attempt to distract Farbauti with music.
No successful escapes using this method have been reported however.
"The reason for their failure is simple: Even Farbauti think your taste in music sucks!"
20000.card_quote: —Posted by "Spike Finger" on the Black-Sweeper's Rock Forum
20000.skill_text: During combat, Farbauti uses its powerful arms to launch continual hammer attacks but those same arms can take damage and become Staggered with enough hits.

20001.card_text:
The HIA Phase-I Investigation Team has officially documented the existence of this sentient living Ether resembling a four-legged beast, which poses significant danger. 
According to rumors, the first sighting took place in Nest Hollow, where individuals exploring the nearby wastes reported hearing ear-splitting roars reminiscent of wild animal growls.
"If I throw a stick or a ball, do you think that monster will catch it?"
"You can give it a try, but I won't cover your medical bill."
20001.skill_text: During combat, Hati uses nimble leaps and quick claw attacks.

20002.card_text:
During initial encounters with these unique Ethereals, Hollow investigators mistakenly thought they possessed some level of intelligence, even showing signs of learning to wield bludgeoning weapons like humans. As a result, they were dubbed "Goblins."
However, subsequent research revealed that their "hammers" were actually twisted and deformed limbs, and that they lacked the ability to imitate human behavior.
Nevertheless, Goblins remain formidable adversaries due to their robust physique and sheer brute strength, with even a simple swing of their limbs proving deadly.
If anything trespasses on their territory, they will immediately enter a state of fury, sparing no effort in mercilessly smashing the intruder.
"Huh? There's a Goblin running over here, banging on a heap of scrap metal."
"Don't you think his attacks have a rhythm to them, like he's playing a drum...?"
"Hey! Don't be stupid, you two! That's not scrap metal! It's our supply truck!"
20002.card_quote: —A Goblin intruder breaks into a gang hideout
20002.skill_text: During combat, Goblin's roar boosts its DMG dealt while significantly reducing DMG taken. However, these effects are interrupted if Stunned.

20003.card_text:
The Armored Hati is widely regarded as a formidable adversary by many experienced Hollow investigators.
Although its armored shell limits its agility, it compensates with exceptional resistance to attacks.
Additionally, the corrupted material on its body forms sharp and hardened protrusions that can cause additional damage when an Armored Hati charges at high speeds.
This creature's agile movements, resilience to blows, and seamless armor compel even the most seasoned explorers to seek alternative routes to avoid direct confrontation.
Some novice Hollow Raiders have attempted to lure Armored Hati away with pet food.
However, these endeavors have proven futile.
"Run! It doesn't like this flavor of dog food!"
20003.card_quote: —Several panicked rookie Hollow Raiders escaping from a Hati in a Hollow
20003.skill_text: During combat, Armored Hati's armor significantly reduces DMG and Daze taken, but Defensive Assist greatly reduces its armor.

20004.card_text:
The debate regarding Metro Goblin is a persistent one. Some scholars argue their peculiar appearance serves as camouflage to confuse their enemies, while others attribute the debris on their bodies to corruption and fusion with old metro equipment.
Nevertheless, the presence of Metro Goblins evokes fear among inexperienced investigators exploring the Hollow's old metro zone.
At any given moment, an ordinary-looking "road sign" may start trembling, and then a formidable Ethereal emerges from the ground, charging menacingly.
"Huh? I saw this sign a few minutes ago. Have we been going in circles?"
"No... That 'road sign' has been following us!"
20004.card_quote: —The horror movie Eternal Lost, the main character looking for a way out of the Hollow
20004.skill_text: During combat, Goblin's roar boosts its DMG dealt while significantly reducing DMG taken. However, these effects are interrupted if Stunned.

20005.card_text:
Many novice Hollow Raiders who come across an Arlaune for the first time are often deceived by its appearance, mistakenly assuming it to be a harmless plant.
However, upon approaching it, they discover that Arlaune release a concentrated discharge of Ether matter, catching their unsuspecting victims off guard.
"Huh? I tried to water it, and it spat at me?"
20005.card_quote: —A group of rookie investigators ambushed by an Arlaune in a Hollow
20005.skill_text: During combat, Arlaune is extremely cunning at launching ranged attacks from a distance. However, Staggering it when its petals are wide open will build up a lot of Daze in just one shot.

20010.card_text:
Based on their research, the Hollow Investigative Association speculates the Tarasque Mixer contains various levels of liquefied Ether.
When it stirs and mixes its stored Ether, a complex reaction takes place, resulting in the release of destructive and violent energy. The power unleashed is comparable to that of the heavy artillery employed by the Defense Force.
Experienced investigators understand the importance of maintaining a low profile to avoid direct bombardment from its heavy artillery.
"When it leaned down towards me, I thought it was some kind of strange welcoming gift. But when its cannon chamber lit up, I realized... it was a farewell gift."
20010.card_quote: —Interview on Back 2 Life, celebrity investigator's personal experiences
20010.skill_text: During combat, Tarasque Mixer uses continual laser attacks while making sideways jumps to reposition.

20022.card_text:
Hornets always seem to be buzzing around Nineveh. Some scholars believe that the two have formed a symbiotic relationship and that, in some respects, they have reached a kind of group coordination.
As Nineveh's energy increases, revealing its distinctive swaying blossom stance, the Hornets enter a frenzied state and try their best to attack any moving target nearby.
"Hey! Something just flew out of that 'flower'!"
"Looks like... a swarm of wasps?"
20022.card_quote: — Hollow Zero Investigation File KU241. Voice recording of the first recorded Hornet sighting.
20022.skill_text: In battle, Hornets will assist Nineveh by distrupting and attacking enemies.

20032.card_text: Not all Ionized beings within the Hollows prefer to hide, and Pugnus wears its menace on every sharpened spike. Clad in armor, its back and tail bristle with razor spines, while its massive pincers serve not only as weapons but as war drums that pound the earth to mark its territory. Pugnus tends to build power from within the shadows, yet can suddenly spring forth — bringing its full weight down with both crushing claws upon its prey. Its shockwaves are powerful enough to throw inexperienced fighters off balance, and the flying debris that follows often seals off any escape routes. Its attack rhythm suggests it relies on ground vibrations to track its prey before lunging in a sudden, explosive strike to finish the fight. Interestingly, some Hollow Raiders who've spent years dealing with Pugnus have developed a unique "Lightfoot Hollow Step" technique: "I used to get knocked off balance by its tremors, but then I learned to step on my toes and move quickly... Now I'm somehow winning stilts racing competitions at festivals."
20032.card_quote: —As shared in "Tales of Hollow Pitfalls" by a self-proclaimed successor of the "Lightfoot Hollow Step".
20032.skill_text: In combat, Ionized - Pugnus tends to unleash continuous hammer attacks with its powerful arms, combining attacks with the spikes on its head and tail. When Ionized - Pugnus slams the ground, it also creates a large area attack.

30000.card_text:
A potent humanoid living Ether, initially observed in the Laketown Hollow and documented by the Third Investigation Team of the Hollow Investigative Association. The exact correlation between these living Ether beings and the downfall of the lakeside town known as Blaise remains uncertain.
Due to their immense power and formidable fighting style, the HIA has labeled them as highly dangerous and advises novice investigators avoid direct confrontations with them.
"Don't let it activate its sword, and if it already has... just don't get cut."
30000.card_quote: —Excerpt from interview with an investigator on the variety show "Teach Me, Senpai!"
30000.skill_text: During combat, Dullahan uses its longsword to charge up and perform a high-level stab, which can be interrupted by your high-level attack.

30001.card_text:
Hollow exploration can be mentally distressing, and Thanatos, with its unique teleportation ability and unpredictable attack patterns, has become a common psychological challenge among Hollow Raiders.
A considerable number of individuals who have faced Thanatos alone in the Hollow have lost all courage to continue their ventures and instead chosen to retire prematurely.
As a result, these elusive entities have become recurring figures in horror movies.
"The slender shadow disappears before your eyes and reappears behind you..."
"What should I do? Now I'm too scared to even go to the restroom alone..."
30001.card_quote: —Night of the premiere of the horror movie "Ethereal Comes Knocking," trending discussion thread on the "Copper Plum" movie review website
30001.skill_text: During combat, Thanatos blinks around to attack from tricky angles, but its Daze buildup when using Defensive Assist and Assist Follow-Up is also very high.

30007.card_text:
Unlike other highly dangerous Ethereals, the Ether within the Dead End Butcher's body often remains in a low-activity dormant state.
Nevertheless, it possesses immense brute strength capable of demolishing any obstacle, and the entire twisted and ravaged metro zone serves as its off-limits kitchen.
Only when a threatening target piques its interest will a horrifying transformation take place...
Within moments, the high concentration of Ether stored in its body undergoes a violent transformation and the exponentially surging energy prompts its limbs to quickly distort, assuming a more brutal and voracious "feeding stance.
The time for "appetizers" is over, and an unparalleled "feast" is about to begin.
Anyone who doesn't want to be part of this feast should be extremely cautious in choosing their route, and stay away from its "kitchen" at all costs.
"The paths within the Hollows are complex, but one thing's for sure, when it appears at the end of the road, that path is a 'dead end.'"
30007.card_quote: —Hollow Investigative Association's 17th Dead End Hollow Investigation
30007.skill_text: During combat, Dead End Butcher's attacks vary greatly. Once enough damage has been taken, phase two attacks become flurried and with the addition of laser attacks. Use a high-level skill once its combo has finished to trigger bonus Stagger.

30010.card_text:
Decades ago, two talented dancer sisters rose to fame overnight. Shining like a meteor, they attracted a massive fan base and held a magnificent performance at the bustling Ballet Twins.
However, as the show neared its end, the Hollow Disaster struck, engulfing the Ballet Twins and plunging the sisters into eternal darkness. The news devastated countless people worldwide.
Rumors suggest that on the day of the performance, the sisters encountered three ominous signs of impending doom. However, driven by their obsession with the stage, applause, and glory, they chose to continue the performance despite the warnings.
Today, only a few images of the elder sister remain, preserved in photographs on yellowed magazines.
Only a few elite Hollow Raiders know that when the shattered spotlight illuminates Ballet Twins once more, the enigmatic Black Veil Marionette emerges. This figure is believed to be connected to Augilia, the dancer from that fateful performance, attempting to finish the grand finale she was never able to complete.
As for those who have the "fortune" to witness her grand finale, they will be haunted by nightmares that last a lifetime.
"If you run into Marionette in the Ballet Twins, don't even think about running away."
"Just sit back and watch her grand finale!" "At least it's a graceful and decent way to die..."
30010.card_quote: —Inter-Knot, complaint from a rookie Hollow Raider
30010.skill_text: In battle, Marionette will teleport to her opponent and unleash a relentless assault.

30011.card_text:
Decades ago, two talented dancer sisters rose to fame overnight. Shining like a meteor, they attracted a massive fan base and held a magnificent performance at the bustling Ballet Twins.
However, as the show neared its end, the Hollow Disaster struck, engulfing the Ballet Twins and plunging the sisters into eternal darkness. The news devastated countless people worldwide.
It is rumored that on the day of the performance, the sisters encountered three ominous signs of impending doom. However, some also believe that they had offended certain forces, ultimately falling victim to the masterminds under the disguise of the "Hollow Disaster," and that the so-called "ominous signs" might have been well-intentioned warnings.
Today, the truth remains buried forever in darkness, as most people can only catch glimpses of the younger sister Augetta's lively dance through scattered video materials.
Only a few elite Hollow Raiders know that when the forgotten dance music echoes within the Ballet Twins, the ethereal figure of Gray Veil Marionette emerges. This figure is believed to be connected to Augetta, the dancer from that fateful performance, attempting to finish the grand finale she was never able to complete.
Her elegant dance steps no longer bring love and beauty to the audience but endless death and despair.
"I can't tell if the Marionette I saw was the elder or the younger sister..."
"Argh! It's not that I don't appreciate art. I just can't tell them apart!"
30011.card_quote: — A post published by a certain Hollow Raider on Inter-Knot
30011.skill_text: In battle, Marionette will teleport to her opponent and unleash a relentless assault.

30012.card_text:
Decades ago, two talented dancer sisters rose to fame overnight. Shining like a meteor, they attracted a massive fan base and held a magnificent performance at the bustling Ballet Twins.
However, as the show neared its end, the Hollow Disaster struck, engulfing the Ballet Twins and plunging the sisters into eternal darkness. The news devastated countless people worldwide.
Today, most people can only catch glimpses of their soulful dance through scattered video and image materials.
Only a few know that when the forgotten dance music echoes within the Ballet Twins, the ethereal figures of the Twin Marionettes emerge. These figures are believed to be connected to the Twin Dancers from that fateful performance, attempting to finish the grand finale they were never able to complete.
"When that eerie tune came to an end, the two Marionettes emerged from the darkness and curtseyed..."
"Huh? So... they're trying to say the show has begun?"
"No, I think what they're trying to say is... It's too late to run. It's over."
30012.card_quote: —"Hollow Interview" Issue 251, an interview with a surviving Hollow investigator
30012.skill_text: During combat, the Twin Marionettes perform a large number of chained attacks. Some of their dance attacks can be interrupted by multiple Defensive Assists, and the twins will attempt to resuscitate the other if one should fall.

30013.card_text:
In a desolate realm completely devoured by the Hollows, it slumbered... until the arrival of "that power."

This aggressive and contaminating force, like a skilled yet malicious craftsman, refilled it with purer dark energy, transforming it into the current "Miasmic Scorpse."

Gradually, it seemed to grasp the trick of "existence" through mimicry. It could split its miasmic energy, creating multiple Mimics indistinguishable from the real thing.

These Mimics possess nearly identical offensive capabilities as the original, launching dazzling attacks from different angles to conceal the one lethal "truth."

When facing its encirclement, remember this well: all you see is illusion. All you feel is a trap.

"Only by filtering out all distractions and perceiving the one 'truth' can you find a glimmer of hope in this deadly dance of phantoms."
30013.skill_text: In battle, Miasma Walker - Scorpse hides itself and uses Mimics to attack players. Triggering a Defensive Assist or Dodge Counter against a Mimic will knock the Miasma Walker - Scorpse down and leave it staggered for a short time. Once it enters a Miasmic Field, it summons additional Mimics to coordinate its attacks. It also spits venom packed with Miasmic - Blastcrawler egg sacs, causing damage through multiple explosions.

30017.card_text:
According to Hollow Raiders, Cyrtoidea's hunting tactics bear resemblance to those of a shark.
It stealthily prowls in the shadows, lurking beneath the surface, and swiftly strikes its prey with deadly precision much like a shark.
Analysis of the data suggests that Cyrtoidea likely relies on ground vibrations to track the movements of its prey. Skilled Hollow Raiders evade detection by constantly altering the rhythm of their footsteps.
"Back in my investigator days, my area was crawling with Cyrtoideas."
"Their attacks had me hopping and jumping all over the place to dodge them..."
"Looking back, it's funny how I unintentionally became a tap dancer..."
30017.card_quote: —"Back 2 Life" Episode 131, an interview featuring Ansor, a renowned master tap-dancer
30017.skill_text: During combat, Ionized: Cyrtoidea uses its sharp head to assault enemies at long range.

30018.card_text:
Each type of Ether mutant in the Hollow exhibits unique fighting styles.
Some are merciless, others cunning, and a few even display a sense of... honor.
Among them, Nassellaria is particularly distinctive.
It often remains motionless out in the open, gathering potent Ether around itself before unleashing its destructive power to eliminate all enemies within its vicinity for other Ethereals.
While Nassellaria is channeling its energy, those accompanying Ethereals engage in frenzied attacks, buying time for the Nassellaria to unleash its devastating attack.
"Quick! Stop that guy! Don't let it unleash its ultimate attack!"
"If we get hit by that attack, we'll end up like those sorry villains in those cliche hero animations!"
30018.card_quote: — Several investigators besieging a Nassellaria within a Hollow
30018.skill_text: During combat, Ionized: Nassellaria charges up attacks for a long time, shooting out high-level energy orbs to attack the enemy. Energy orbs attacked with Ether damage or a high-level attack during charge up will fall down, damaging enemies in the surrounding area.

30020.card_text:
Even among Ionized enemies renowned for their strange and uncanny qualities, Ionized Doppelgangers are exceptionally unique.
These entities can coat their bodies with a layer of special active Ether ions, enabling them to accurately replicate their target's form, often to a degree that makes it hard to tell the difference. Both in detail and texture, it is almost impossible to tell apart from the original.
Even more challenging is their ability to mimic the powerful and intimidating combat techniques of their targets.
No one knows where they obtain the information about the subjects they mimic. Some rumors suggest they can read minds, picking out the most suitable challengers from their opponent's memories, and then attack in that form.
"Nonsense! If it could really read my deepest fears, it would turn into a fierce middle-aged woman wielding a clothes hanger! That's right, I'm most afraid of my mom!"
30020.skill_text: During combat, this enemy performs attacks that perfectly mimic those of its target, launching extremely aggressive attacks. When necessary, it can parry and counter enemy strikes, but it usually exposes a weakness after finishing its combo.

30023.card_text:
This fearsome Ethereal, named after the warrior tribes of ancient mythology, is said to be the embodiment of the most valiant heroes and the most insane villains corrupted by the Ether.
— But that's not the case. While the chiseled muscles you developed in the Hollow and the adrenaline released in excess before death may indeed help you become a significant nuisance to your former companions, they probably won't hold it against an old friend who's already beyond saving, right?
But it's irrelevant. When your handsome face transforms into a dark, eerie energy orb, who cares about social reputation?
"No wonder he's the boss. Even as an Ethereal, he's still formidable!"
"I knew something was off when he was always in the gym!"
30023.card_quote: — Confession screamed by a captured Hollow Raider
30023.skill_text: During combat, Thracian will repeatedly perform specific skills to enter a charging state. While in this state, their attacks become more aggressive, and after unleashing high-level moves, they will trigger a large-scale explosion.

30025.card_text:
Ether is a greedy, insatiable parasite, a vicious creature that devours once-vibrant lives.
The Hitchspiker is an even more malicious incarnation of Ether — dwelling within the bodies of its cruel counterparts, it enables Tyrfing and Alpeca to satisfy the voracious appetites of the Hollows in an even more ferocious manner.
"Get away from my face!"
30025.card_quote: —An Ethereal Ecologist, realizing that this is just a very jumpy bug
30025.skill_text: In combat, Hitchspiker will continue to roam, searching for any Tyrfing and Alpeca that can be parasitized.

30029.card_text:
Even among Ionized enemies renowned for their strange and uncanny qualities, Ionized Doppelgangers are exceptionally unique.
These entities can coat their bodies with a layer of special active Ether ions, enabling them to accurately replicate their target's form, often to a degree that makes it hard to tell the difference. Both in detail and texture, it is almost impossible to tell apart from the original.
Even more challenging is their ability to mimic the powerful and intimidating combat techniques of their targets.
No one knows where they obtain the information about the subjects they mimic. Some rumors suggest they can read minds, picking out the most suitable challengers from their opponent's memories, and then attack in that form.
"Nonsense! If it could really read my deepest fears, it would turn into a fierce middle-aged woman wielding a clothes hanger! That's right, I'm most afraid of my mom!"
30029.card_quote: — Inter-Knot forum complaint from a Hollow Raider
30029.skill_text: During combat, this enemy can copy the moves of whoever it copies.

30031.card_text:
Ethereals that are always seen in pairs, distinguished by their peculiar physical traits. A profound bond exists between the two.
 
"Whoa, that was close! Don't just deal with one. You gotta watch out for the ladies' sneak attacks!"
"Hold on, 'ladies'? Has being in the Hollow for so long made you see even the Ethereals as attractive?"
"Dude, I know Ethereals and I know ladies. I swear, Palicus are definitely 'ladies'."
"No way!"
"That long hair? Those legs? They're like total 'factory-made babes' — my sister taught me that term."
"How's your sister doing lately?"
"She's actually getting better. But next month's medical bills? Gotta hustle that cash from these Ethereal hotties."
"Ain't easy being an older brother, eh? Here's the deal: I'll keep Palicus busy, and you give me your sister's number."
"Hah. Like I'm actually gonna give you her number!"
30031.card_quote: —The last words of two young Hollow Raiders
30031.skill_text: In combat, the Palicus fight by combining both close and ranged attacks. When one dies, the other will enter a Frenzy state, increasing the speed and ferocity of its attacks.

30032.card_text:
Among the most fearsome symbiotic entities in Hollow Zero, Geppetto, thanks to its distinctive posture, often leaves an unsettling first impression.
Its immense, terrifying form harbors violent Ether energy, yet it moves with the unsettling grace of a puppet, often performing strange and unpredictable actions. In the absence of sufficient observational data, an encounter with Geppetto in Hollow Zero typically heralds enormous dread and inescapable death for any investigator.
Some scholars speculate, drawing from the records of Parasitic Ethereal Swarm, that this horrific outer shell is merely a facade, while a volatile potent Ether Core lies in command within.
Regrettably, no investigation records regarding this mysterious core have yet come to light.
"I've never met the Grim Reaper, but I've definitely seen what his puppet looks like."
30032.card_quote: —Special Feature of Interview on Back 2 Life, talks with an elite investigator of Hollow Zero
30032.skill_text: In combat, Geppetto unleashes large area attacks using both its body and Ether energy. After its hands and tail take sufficient DMG, they'll be destroyed, leaving it paralyzed. Geppetto will repair these destroyed parts when summoning Ether enemies or deploying Curtain of Phantoms. Additionally, Geppetto's Curtain of Phantoms inflicts the Suspended status on enemies who touch it, reducing their movement speed and preventing Skill usage.

30033.card_text:
For New Eridu, the Hollow is a catastrophe of despair. And when a Hollow expands, fear, death, suffering... all forms of despair devour people's minds, altering the fates of countless souls.
The omens of doom began in the shadows of the Hollow, yet some heard a strange calling within, glimpsing a sliver of... hope and redemption amidst despair.
Since then, they heeded that secret call to form a clandestine organization, and the Miasma Priests lurked in the shadows of Eridu... spreading Their blessing to those who had lost their way.
The "Miasma Priests" believe that the Hollow's expansion is no mere natural disaster. Generation after generation, the "Priests" have tirelessly pursued the hidden truth behind it, seeking to achieve their desired truth... that the will within the Hollow shall ultimately become reality.
However, sacrifices are necessary in this process, and minor troubles are inevitable. Even being targeted by Void Hunters and hunted by major organizations are merely trivial setbacks on the path to truth.
After a lengthy effort and thorough preparation, the "Miasma Priests" have finally summoned that will from the Hollow, allowing it to descend upon the world with near-perfect form. The Miasma that coils and covers the "Miasma Priests," that corrupting substance untouchable to others, has become for them dazzling weapons and armor.
All of this serves as the ultimate proof of their blessed status.
"Their will... shall finally descend upon this world."
"What you must do is simple..."
"Listen, obey, and then... accept Their blessing!"
30033.card_quote: — A Miasma Priest performing a ritual
30033.skill_text: During combat, the Miasma Priest will switch between different phases and use special skills for each phase. When Agents activate Perfect Assist against some of the Miasma Priest's skills, it won't consume Assist Points, and after multiple Defensive Assist activations in a short time, the Miasma Priest will enter a special Stagger state, during which Agents can deal increased DMG to the Miasma Priest.

35001.card_text:
The unique and magnificent appearance of the symbiotic Ethereal swarm known as Nineveh make it "difficult" for people to be wary of it.
According to the few research records available, as Nineveh extends its body, a concentrated and potent Ether flows towards its core through its "rhizome," providing a constant supply of energy. Some scholars speculate that this behavior is akin to the photosynthesis process in plants.
In the course of its swaying motions, excess highly active Ether energy continuously pours out. When this accumulation of highly active Ether is nearly overflowing, it transforms, unveiling its true "blossoming" form.
And with its bloom comes death.
"The good news is it doesn't mean any harm, it just absorbs nutrients for photosynthesis. The bad news is... we're the nutrients."
35001.card_quote: —Defense Force Hollow Zero Investigation Log K-411
35001.skill_text: In battle, Nineveh will use attacks with wide areas of effect, barrage opponents with missiles, and summon Hornets to aid her.

100001.card_text:
The Hollow Investigative Association has been studying Tyrfing's behavioral patterns, and research results show that its seemingly unbalanced stance of swaying and skewing is, in fact, a highly efficient stance for launching successive slashing attacks.
Due to its frequent appearances and aggressive behavior, Tyrfing has been identified as one of the most deadly Ethereals in the Hollow, particularly for certain Hollow personnel.
When faced with a shielded enemy, it relentlessly launches attacks until either its enemy or itself is destroyed.
"Perhaps... they don't actually hate us, but just think of us as punching bags for practice?"
100001.card_quote: —Midnight talk show "Back 2 Life," Episode 165, featuring retired riot patrol officer due to injury, Nobby Kereyan
100001.skill_text: During combat, Tyrfing will perform melee attacks.

The Hollow Investigative Association has limited research on Alpeca. After briefly studying its behavioral pattern of spewing liquid Ether, the Association classified Alpeca as a low-threat Ethereal and ended its investigation.
Scholars once showed great interest in observing how Alpeca spews liquefied Ether and even commissioned surveys for closer observation.
Experienced investigators have been avoiding such tasks for unknown reasons, however.
"Run! They're spitting again... Oh, no! My new clothes!"
100011.card_quote: —Deep within a Hollow, rookie investigator Raffaele Bert attempting to retreat
100011.skill_text: During combat, Alpeca will perform scattered ranged attacks.

100021.card_text:
A living humanoid Ether that was first spotted in the Hollow in the New Eridu metro. It once raised debate among the Hollow Investigative Association, as some believed it to be living Ether converted from the Corrupted, while others claimed it to be pure living Ether affected by the Hollow environment. The Association considers it of low threat due to its limited intelligence, but one should never underestimate them, as they usually appear in groups.
"Have you ever been late or fined because of a red light? Feels terrible, right?"
"Well, here's your chance to blow off some steam!"
100021.card_quote: —"Planet of Disaster" forum, comment from user "Waitin4BangbooPricetoDrop"
100021.skill_text: During combat, Faun tends to perform charged heavy attacks that are hard to interrupt.

100031.card_text:
While categorized by the Hollow Investigative Association as a "low threat" Ethereal, Hoplitai prove to be a formidable opponent for novice Hollow Raiders and investigators.
Its forelimbs are covered in a thick inert Ether matter, serving as both a tough shield and an intimidating weapon.
The only drawback is its top-heavy appearance, making it not look very clever.
"Alright, guys... Check out this sorry excuse... This is Hoplitai."
"When Ethereals gather together to play rock-paper-scissors, this idiot always plays paper!"
100031.skill_text: During combat, Hoplitai uses a shielded arms charge at opponents and block attacks.

100041.card_text:
According to research reports conducted by the Hollow Investigative Association, Blastcrawlers, with their low mobility and causing only small explosions, are classified as a "low-threat," "non-concern" lower-tier Ethereal.
However, astute businessmen have recognized the opportunities presented by their rounded bodies and short legs.
A film titled "Roll Over, Little Blastcrawler" gained significant popularity, leading to the sale of merchandise like Blastcrawler dolls and pillows at remarkably high prices.
"I didn't expect their dolls to be more deadly than the real deal... on your wallet at least. Looks like I'll be surviving on instant noodles next month, Billy..."
100041.card_quote: —Anby checking her wallet in front of the shopping street crane machine.

100141.card_text:
Mandrake derive their name from a toxic herb. The scholar who initially assigned the name believed there was a resemblance between the two solely based on their appearance.
While blooming, Mandrake emit heat rays targeting nearby objects, while sturdy leaves anchor it firmly to the ground, preventing uprooting. When threatened, Mandrake may use their sharp leaves for self-defense.
Similar to the legend of their namesake, Mandrake cries can be highly deadly.
"Stay away! It's gonna bloom any second now!"
100141.card_quote: —Mandrake blooming in the movie Deep Fear
100141.skill_text: During combat, different Mandrakes provide periodic ATK/Shield buffs to adjacent units.

100251.card_text:
Due to its unique and grotesque shape, Ahriman is often mistaken for an art sculpture in the Ballet Twins.
As a result, many novice investigators are left with lifelong trauma when they first encounter an Ahriman...
You just passed by a certain "sculpture" when it suddenly moves...
And that fearful moment frozen in place is the perfect moment for Ahriman to launch a surprise attack.
"Corin, don't be fooled by how it looks... It's no fancy art."
"Now, let's clean it up."
100251.card_quote: — Lycaon instructing Corin to clean up
100251.skill_text: During combat, Ahriman unleashes teleporting assaults and sometimes even teams up with another Ahriman to launch coordinated attacks.

100261.card_text:
Influenced by the distinctive decor of the interior of the Ballet Twins, Specters have the grotesque and twisted limb configuration of an artistic sculpture.
Some investigators believe its unique shape is intended to enhance the protection of its Ether Core.
Others argue it's merely a trick designed to distract its enemies. While its enemies are mesmerized by its peculiar posture, a Specter will seize the opportunity to launch long-range attacks using concentrated Ether.
"I looked at its bizarre structure and thought to myself: Was it trying to play a game of bowling with its own head?"
"But before I could make sense of anything, its bowling ball had already smashed into my face..."
100261.card_quote: —Posted by an anonymous user on Inter-Knot
100261.skill_text: During combat, Specter unleashes a burst of ranged attacks in quick succession.

100301.card_text:
Recent studies by the Whitestar Institute reveal that some Ethereals' limbs carry notable features from their environment.
Fossor is a prime example of this — its strange forelimbs bear a striking resemblance to the drilling equipment found in the Old Oil Field region.
Although some suggest this is a camouflage tactic to deceive enemies, others have pointed out that Fossor's combat style is aggressive and direct, making it appear ill-suited for ambushes.
Some imaginative Hollow Raiders speculate it may have developed this form just to dig for minerals...
"When I caught sight of it from a distance, it seemed to be happily digging up the asphalt."
"When it spotted me, it didn't hesitate to charge straight at me, desperately trying to drive me away..."
"But I was just passing by! I had absolutely no intention of taking any of its junk!"
100301.card_quote: — A rookie Hollow Raider outside a Hollow, recounting his recent experience to his companions
100301.skill_text: During combat, Fossor performs consecutive double-handed slashes.

100311.card_text:
The Hollows of the Outer Ring are home to a variety of bizarre Ethereals, and Sordidus is a prime example.
They possess a unique body structure, with highly flexible limbs that seem to be the result of an unknown reaction between crude oil and active Ether.
Once they lock onto a target, they use their limbs like expert acrobats, launching aggressive and brutal attacks.
"Damn it... That thing actually whipped me!"
"Does it see itself as a tamer, treating us like wild beasts?"
100311.card_quote: — Inside the Hollow, a group of rookie Hollow Raiders battling a Sordidus
100311.skill_text: During combat, Sordidus will whip with its tentacles for close-range attacks or insert its tentacles into the ground for long-range surprise attacks.

200001.card_text:
Farbauti, possessing immense strength and often in a frenzied state, is one of the most formidable threats Hollow Raiders may face. Its hammer-like arms can effortlessly deflect damage and unleash storms of blows that crush everything in its path.
Some Hollow Raiders have observed Farbauti frequently pounding the ground in a rhythmic, high-frequency manner, leading to speculation about its peculiar interest in drumming music.
Despite the Hollow Investigative Association publicly debunking this rumor, many Hollow Raiders carry portable stereos in an attempt to distract Farbauti with music.
No successful escapes using this method have been reported however.
"The reason for their failure is simple: Even Farbauti think your taste in music sucks!"
200001.card_quote: —Posted by "Spike Finger" on the Black-Sweeper's Rock Forum
200001.skill_text: During combat, Farbauti uses its powerful arms to launch continual hammer attacks but those same arms can take damage and become Staggered with enough hits.

However, subsequent research revealed that their "hammers" were actually twisted and deformed limbs, and that they lacked the ability to imitate human behavior.
Nevertheless, Goblins remain formidable adversaries due to their robust physique and sheer brute strength, with even a simple swing of their limbs proving deadly.
If anything trespasses on their territory, they will immediately enter a state of fury, sparing no effort in mercilessly smashing the intruder.
"Huh? There's a Goblin running over here, banging on a heap of scrap metal."
"Don't you think his attacks have a rhythm to them, like he's playing a drum...?"
"Hey! Don't be stupid, you two! That's not scrap metal! It's our supply truck!"

200021.skill_text: During combat, Goblin's roar boosts its DMG dealt while significantly reducing DMG taken. However, these effects are interrupted if Stunned.

200031.card_text:
The Armored Hati is widely regarded as a formidable adversary by many experienced Hollow investigators.
Although its armored shell limits its agility, it compensates with exceptional resistance to attacks.
Additionally, the corrupted material on its body forms sharp and hardened protrusions that can cause additional damage when an Armored Hati charges at high speeds.
This creature's agile movements, resilience to blows, and seamless armor compel even the most seasoned explorers to seek alternative routes to avoid direct confrontation.
Some novice Hollow Raiders have attempted to lure Armored Hati away with pet food.
However, these endeavors have proven futile.
"Run! It doesn't like this flavor of dog food!"
200031.card_quote: —Several panicked rookie Hollow Raiders escaping from a Hati in a Hollow
200031.skill_text: During combat, Armored Hati's armor significantly reduces DMG and Daze taken, but Defensive Assist greatly reduces its armor.

However, upon approaching it, they discover that Arlaune release a concentrated discharge of Ether matter, catching their unsuspecting victims off guard.
"Huh? I tried to water it, and it spat at me?"
200051.card_quote: —A group of rookie investigators ambushed by an Arlaune in a Hollow
200051.skill_text: During combat, Arlaune is extremely cunning at launching ranged attacks from a distance. However, Staggering it when its petals are wide open will build up a lot of Daze in just one shot.

200231.card_text:
Even among Ionized enemies renowned for their strange and uncanny qualities, Ionized Doppelgangers are exceptionally unique.
These entities can coat their bodies with a layer of special active Ether ions, enabling them to accurately replicate their target's form, often to a degree that makes it hard to tell the difference. Both in detail and texture, it is almost impossible to tell apart from the original.
Even more challenging is their ability to mimic the powerful and intimidating combat techniques of their targets.
No one knows where they obtain the information about the subjects they mimic. Some rumors suggest they can read minds, picking out the most suitable challengers from their opponent's memories, and then attack in that form.
"Nonsense! If it could really read my deepest fears, it would turn into a fierce middle-aged woman wielding a clothes hanger! That's right, I'm most afraid of my mom!"

200231.skill_text: During combat, this enemy performs attacks that perfectly mimic those of its target, and depending on the battlefield situation, will choose between close-range combos or long-range shooting. 300071.card_text:
Unlike other highly dangerous Ethereals, the Ether within the Dead End Butcher's body often remains in a low-activity dormant state.
Nevertheless, it possesses immense brute strength capable of demolishing any obstacle, and the entire twisted and ravaged metro zone serves as its off-limits kitchen.
Only when a threatening target piques its interest will a horrifying transformation take place...
Within moments, the high concentration of Ether stored in its body undergoes a violent transformation and the exponentially surging energy prompts its limbs to quickly distort, assuming a more brutal and voracious "feeding stance.
The time for "appetizers" is over, and an unparalleled "feast" is about to begin.
Anyone who doesn't want to be part of this feast should be extremely cautious in choosing their route, and stay away from its "kitchen" at all costs.
"The paths within the Hollows are complex, but one thing's for sure, when it appears at the end of the road, that path is a 'dead end.'"
300071.card_quote: —Hollow Investigative Association's 17th Dead End Hollow Investigation
300071.skill_text: During combat, Newborn Dead End Butcher's attacks vary greatly. Once enough damage has been taken, phase two attacks become flurried and with the addition of laser attacks. Use a high-level skill once its combo has finished to trigger bonus Stagger. Newborn Dead End Butcher performs nimble dodges to evade enemy attacks.

300072.card_text:
Unlike other highly dangerous Ethereals, the Ether within the Dead End Butcher's body often remains in a low-activity dormant state.
Nevertheless, it possesses immense brute strength capable of demolishing any obstacle, and the entire twisted and ravaged metro zone serves as its off-limits kitchen.
Only when a threatening target piques its interest will a horrifying transformation take place...
Within moments, the high concentration of Ether stored in its body undergoes a violent transformation and the exponentially surging energy prompts its limbs to quickly distort, assuming a more brutal and voracious "feeding stance.
The time for "appetizers" is over, and an unparalleled "feast" is about to begin.
Anyone who doesn't want to be part of this feast should be extremely cautious in choosing their route, and stay away from its "kitchen" at all costs.
"The paths within the Hollows are complex, but one thing's for sure, when it appears at the end of the road, that path is a 'dead end.'"
300072.card_quote: —Hollow Investigative Association's 17th Dead End Hollow Investigation
300072.skill_text: In combat, the notorious Dead End Butcher can skillfully utilize Ether Energy to unleash various ranged attacks and enter an "Ether Enhanced" state to boost their ATK; Dazing them will cancel their "Ether Enhanced" state.

300121.card_text:
Decades ago, two talented dancer sisters rose to fame overnight. Shining like a meteor, they attracted a massive fan base and held a magnificent performance at the bustling Ballet Twins.
However, as the show neared its end, the Hollow Disaster struck, engulfing the Ballet Twins and plunging the sisters into eternal darkness. The news devastated countless people worldwide.
Today, most people can only catch glimpses of their soulful dance through scattered video and image materials.
Only a few know that when the forgotten dance music echoes within the Ballet Twins, the ethereal figures of the Twin Marionettes emerge. These figures are believed to be connected to the Twin Dancers from that fateful performance, attempting to finish the grand finale they were never able to complete.
"When that eerie tune came to an end, the two Marionettes emerged from the darkness and curtseyed..."
"Huh? So... they're trying to say the show has begun?"
"No, I think what they're trying to say is... It's too late to run. It's over."
300121.card_quote: —"Hollow Interview" Issue 251, an interview with a surviving Hollow Investigator
300121.skill_text: In combat, Notorious - Marionette will summon her dance partner to attack. Every time her dance partner is defeated, her next Stun's duration will be increased.

300301.card_text:
Even among Ionized enemies renowned for their strange and uncanny qualities, Ionized Doppelgangers are exceptionally unique.
These entities can coat their bodies with a layer of special active Ether ions, enabling them to accurately replicate their target's form, often to a degree that makes it hard to tell the difference. Both in detail and texture, it is almost impossible to tell apart from the original.
Even more challenging is their ability to mimic the powerful and intimidating combat techniques of their targets.
No one knows where they obtain the information about the subjects they mimic. Some rumors suggest they can read minds, picking out the most suitable challengers from their opponent's memories, and then attack in that form.
"Nonsense! If it could really read my deepest fears, it would turn into a fierce middle-aged woman wielding a clothes hanger! That's right, I'm most afraid of my mom!"
300301.card_quote: —Inter-Knot forum complaint from a Hollow Raider
300301.skill_text: In combat, the Doppelganger Abyssal Enforcer will actively evade enemies and activate Vital View, followed by a powerful rush attack. This skill can be countered with Perfect Dodge or Perfect Assist.

300371.card_text:
A fallen creation, reforged in the depths of filth and gloom.
Even among Ionized enemies known for their strange and uncanny qualities, Ionized Doppelgangers stand out as particularly exceptional.
These creatures cloak themselves in a special layer of active Ether ions, allowing them to precisely mimic the appearance of their targets — sometimes so accurately it's nearly impossible to tell the difference. From details to texture, they're masters at blurring the line between real and false.
What makes them even more dangerous is their ability to replicate their targets' powerful combat techniques.
No one knows how they acquire such detailed intel of their targets. Some say they can read minds, pulling the perfect nightmare from their opponent's memory and taking that shape before launching their attack.
"Nonsense! If it could really read my deepest fears, it would turn into a fierce middle-aged woman wielding a clothes hanger! That's right, I'm most afraid of my mom!"
300371.card_quote: — Inter-Knot forum complaint from a Hollow Raider
300371.skill_text: In combat, this enemy uses identical skills to those of their target, launching fierce attacks with blades and guns.

930166.card_text:
Under the long-lasting distortion of control in the name of love, the girl resorts to lying to deceive the suffering victims who have lost their loved ones to the Hollows, all in the pursuit of attention and love from her closest kin.
She believed that as long as she helped her loved ones hide the secret of the "Blessing" medicine, as long as she could not hear the agonizing screams of the people being affected by corruption, and as long as this secret and vile experiment remained concealed, the bond between her and her loved ones would not break.
But in the end, what awaited her was witnessing her loved one take his last breath in a pool of blood.

After that, hatred and jealousy, like sharp thorns, constantly pierced her heart.
The gears of vengeance gnawed at every ounce of her sanity, and she pieced together a twisted meaning of existence from the notes left behind by her loved one.
Her life trajectory seemed like a dark fable about obsession.

When former companions extended their hands of salvation to her, the girl could no longer turn back. Or rather, the words that tried to pull her back into the light were torn to shreds by the jealousy, obsession, and hatred that had burrowed deep into her bones.
In the end, as the sun was about to set, countless spikes surged forth, bursting from her body, each bone shard piercing the screams of the forsaken.
Tepes – the pitiful one pierced by thorns - walks toward the deeper abyss with hatred.
"Especially at night, its voice is more sorrowful than that of other remains, and if you listen closely, the sound seems like the cry of a woman..."
930166.card_quote: — Notes written by a scholar of the White Star Institute after carefully listening to the recording.
930166.skill_text: During the battle, Tepes frequently uses the spiked hammers in both hands to launch powerful attacks and inflict a damage reduction effect. Successfully executing Defensive Assists multiple times to block Tepes' hand attacks will Impair its spiked hammers. Once the hammers are Impaired, some of Tepes' moves will reveal significant openings, the damage reduction effect will be lost, and Tepes will be inflicted with an increased Daze Vulnerability.

930168.card_text:
In the Hollow Investigative Association's reports, Banyrek has been repeatedly marked as "dangerous" mainly due to its all-too-great jumping prowess.
If an Ethereal Olympics were held in the Hollow, it would definitely sweep both the high jump and long jump championships. Observation data indicates that Banyrek can bounce continuously for hours without showing any signs of fatigue, as if the space between air and ground were some natural runway.
Some researchers have joked that if they ever released it in New Eridu's urban district, it would probably bounce from west to east in less than a day.

"How about trying to tame it as a mount?"
"Forget it, with that explosive kinetic energy, it might be more cost-effective to use it for power generation directly."
930168.card_quote: — A casual chat with a Hollow Raider who fled the Hollow after a face-to-face encounter with Banyrek, sweating all the while
930168.skill_text: During combat, Banyrek will use a spitting skill to generate Miasma Pools on the ground, which it will actively absorb to enhance its skills. Additionally, its skills possess strong Miasma Corruption capabilities, and when certain skills hit a Miasma Pool, they will trigger an explosion.

930169.card_text:
In Hollow Investigative Association reports, Avarus is often jokingly referred to as the embodiment of "the sin of gluttony" — its pot-bellied figure makes it look every bit the lazy bum, about to doze off at any moment.
Don't underestimate it, however. Observation data indicates that Avarus can compress its body into a ball and launch devastating strikes at targets with astonishing speed.
As to how it maintains such a rotund figure despite its intense physical activity, the Association has yet to reach a conclusion.

"The way it rolls around always reminds me of my pet hamster — it's just a bigger, y'know?"
"More than just a bit bigger, I'd say..."
930169.card_quote: — Hollow Investigator Observation Log, excerpted from casual chat between two observers
930169.skill_text: During combat, Miasma Ravager Avarus will use its massive body to perform rolling attacks. If you successfully counter this skill with Defensive Assists 3 times in a row, you can interrupt its rolling attack and expose its weakness. After taking a certain amount of DMG in battle, it will activate a Miasmic Field.

930171.card_text:
Feeding primarily on rookie investigators, newbie Hollow Raiders, and greedy, reckless beginner adventurers, the Fisher Crab - the most patient hunter in the Hollow, fishing for fools.
Before rushing towards that "Hollow Supply Container," remember:
Don't become tonight's dinner party joke among colleagues, or tomorrow morning's mass-distributed obituary.

"A mimic? You've been playing too many tabletop games, haven't you?"
930171.card_quote: — Audio log submitted by a rookie investigator for supplies recovery during a workplace injury claim.
930171.skill_text: In combat, the Fisher Crab moves swiftly sideways, unleashing fierce attacks with its dual pincers while protecting itself with a tough shell. After taking heavy hits, the Fisher Crab enters defense mode. If its shell is intact, it will exit defense mode after a while and launch a devastating counter-attack. However, if its shell is gone and it takes multiple hits, the Fisher Crab will be executed and enter a paralyzed state.

930172.card_text:
The Huskron's dual forms — pre and post-hatching — have been giving headaches to new and veteran investigators alike. The Hollow Investigative Association offers this advice: Always watch for Miasmic substances at your feet. If you spot any rock-like spherical objects, attack immediately! Don't hesitate! Don't hesitate!
According to insiders, the advice originally didn't have that repetition — until some clever Hollow Investigators still tried stepping around Huskrons even after reading it. That strategy worked about as well as trying to quietly open the fridge late at night without alerting one's dog.

"I prefer how it looks before hatching — all round and rolly."
"Is that why you didn't attack it first...?"
930172.card_quote: — A conversation between Anne and Bessa, two Trainee Investigators who just escaped death in the Hollow
930172.skill_text: In combat, Huskron moves cautiously and actively takes a defensive stance when facing player attacks, launching powerful counterattacks. If you successfully perform Defensive Assists against these counterattacks, it will become stunned.

930173.card_text:
Arcavor's coral-like glowing head never fails to catch the attention of rookie Hollow Raiders. Many find themselves unconsciously mesmerized, staring blankly in fascination — unaware that the danger has only just begun.
Taking advantage of any such distraction, Arcavor gracefully raises its slender legs, striking a pose that's nothing short of an acrobatic miracle — the Hollow Investigative Association's records even describe it as reminiscent of a ballet dancer twirling on ice.
However, the Association's warning is crystal clear: when you see it strike this pose, you'd better roll, jump, or back away immediately, because it's aiming for a lethal strike.

"Seriously, did this one miss its calling? It could've been a superstar as a dance performer, acrobat, or even a figure skater! But no, it just has to hang out in the Hollow and attack people..."
930173.card_quote: — Posted on the Planet of Disaster forum by a Hollow Raider who experienced an "artistically heavy attack"
930173.skill_text: During combat, Miasma Walker Arcavor will continuously fire from long range; after being knocked down for the first time, they will stand back up if they come in contact with Miasma Pools.

930178.card_text:
A fallen creation, reshaped in the depths of profound darkness and impurity.

This fearsome Ethereal, named after a warrior tribe in ancient mythology, is said to only manifest from the most valiant heroes and the most insane villains when they become corrupted by the Ether.
That is not the case, however. While the chiseled muscles you developed in the Hollow and the adrenaline released in excess before death may indeed help you become a significant nuisance to your former companions, they probably won't hold it against an old friend who's already beyond saving, right?
Not that it matters, of course. Who cares about street cred or socializing once your handsome face has transformed into a dark, eerie energy orb, anyway?
"That's the Boss for ya. Even his Ether-corrupted form is super strong!"
"I always knew something was off about that gym freak!"
930178.card_quote: — Shrieking confession made by a captured Hollow Raider gang member
930178.skill_text: During combat, this enemy will activate Miasmic Fields at specific moments, instantly unleashing a powerful large-area attack, while enhancing their skills throughout its duration.
