940001.skill_text:
HP: Low
ATK: Medium
Movement Speed: Fast
Threat Level: <color=#31CC00>Low</color>

10015.card_text:
Among the ranks of Ether thieves, Raiders and Looters serve as the core members, possessing both technical expertise and combat skills.
Their Electric Resonance Detection Devices emit powerful currents that are used to detect Ether ore and also function as formidable weapons during armed raids.
Occasionally mistaken for illegal fishermen, they pay little attention to such misconceptions.
After all, with their extremely lethal electro-shockers, they don't really care whether their targets are fish or humans...
"If you encounter individuals armed with electrified harpoons, whether near a river, lake, or Hollow, please report it immediately to Public Security!"
10015.card_quote: —New Eridu Public Security slogan played repeatedly through promotional cars
10015.skill_text: During combat, Hollow Thug - Raider will charge from a long distance, potentially colliding with obstacles along the way — creating the perfect opportunity to counterattack.

10016.card_text:
For Pyromaniacs and Arsonists, robbing passersby is merely a side hustle. Deep down, they consider themselves as adept bartenders who actively seek excitement.
With precision and skill, they expertly blend various types of Ether into their beverages, effortlessly concocting bottles of highly flammable and explosive "exclusive brew."
Unlike other brutal Hollow Raiders, they often offer their victims a choice.
If the victim agrees to pay the toll, they extend the courtesy of a free drink.
However, if the victim declines, the flammable "exclusive brew" will be forcefully shattered upon their head.
"How about we trick those guys into drinking their own weapon stash?"
10016.card_quote: —Inside the Hollow, robbed investigator quietly discussing strategies for retreating
10016.skill_text: During combat, Hollow Thug - Pyromaniac will sometimes bombard using a hail of molotov cocktails.

10018.card_text:
Most of the thugs who spend their time in the Hollows exhibit serious mental problems or peculiar quirks. Fortunately, the Poachers and the Rustlers within the gang have managed to maintain their sanity while embracing the filthy methods of traditional villains.
Cowardly and cunning, they excel in the art of concealing themselves within the shadows and launching surprise attacks on their targets. They would never choose to attack head-on if they could ambush.
Their composite hand crossbows, though limited in power, produce minimal noise when fired. Seasoned Poachers often seize the perfect moment and immobilize their unsuspecting prey with a single well-aimed shot.
"I used to be a Public Security officer, then I took an arrow in the knee while on a Hollow operation..."
10018.card_quote: —A senior member of the Nightingale Security Company talking to a rookie
10018.skill_text: During combat, Hollow Thug - Poacher tends to harass targets at a distance using 3-shot bursts.

10019.card_text:
As the vanguards in Hollow Raider gangs, Assaulters and Ambushers often brandish their weapons and charge ahead independently.
This isn't because of their recklessness or disregard for teamwork, but rather a precautionary measure to prevent accidental harm. The modified transformer coils in their hands release high-voltage currents upon contact, capable of paralyzing or even knocking out an opponent with just a touch.
And in the logistically difficult Hollows, an incapacitated teammate could pose a terrible challenge for an entire squad.
"What's this? Lemme check it out! Oh, it's some electric baton replicaaaa... Aaaaaaaaaaarrghhh..."
10019.card_quote: —Final words of a curious novice investigator before falling to the ground in a Hollow
10019.skill_text: During combat, Hollow Thug - Assaulter launches continual spinning assaults, but this crazy suicidal attack often reveals a weakness after.

20015.card_text:
In contrast to fully equipped Hollow investigators, Bulky Intimidators and Wanted Intimidators possess minimalistic gear.
Nevertheless, these notorious thugs can easily instill fear in their victims with their makeshift equipment.
A spiked metal bat and a modified double-barreled shotgun are all they need to establish themselves as the most feared brutes in the Hollow.
According to investigators who have encountered them in the Hollows, these brutes enter an extreme state of euphoria during battle. Their "demeanor" could hardly be called combat suitable, and more closely resembles bullying.
"Fighting them brought back the fear I felt when facing the school bullies alone..."
20015.card_quote: —Hollow Investigative Association Resignation Letter from a rookie investigator
20015.skill_text: During combat, Hollow Thug - Bulky Intimidator switches between using a club and a shotgun for nearby attacks while sometimes kicking up sand to launch an ambush.

20017.card_text:
There is a consensus within the New Eridu underworld that the most formidable fighters are not the champions of the ring, but rather the Bulky Enforcers and Wanted Enforcers lurking in the depths of the Hollow. These professional thugs are hired by Ether thieves at high prices to protect their illegally excavated Ether resources.
Being ardent boxing enthusiasts, Bulky Enforcers have modified high-voltage stun guns into boxing gloves, augmenting the destructive power of their punches.
To them, Ethereals, Hollow Raiders, Hollow investigators, and even scattered members of Public Security... are not seen as opponents but merely as "training sandbags" for their personal amusement.
"Wait a minute! I think I've seen this guy's fighting stance in the arcade on Fourth Street!"
20017.card_quote: —Billy dealing with a charging thug in a Hollow
20017.skill_text: During combat, Hollow Thug - Bulky Enforcer uses both fists to punch while using nimble sidesteps to shake up the angle of attack.

20020.card_text:
A significant number of combat mechs belonging to Public Security are destroyed within Hollow each year. Some of these mechs are subsequently repaired by Hollow thugs and illegally modified into Enraged Sweepers. 
Despite lacking access to standard parts or professional repair services, the thugs manage to restore these mechs using makeshift components, striving to maintain their original combat capabilities.
In their pursuit of individuality, the thugs often apply custom paint jobs and even install high-powered loudspeakers on their Enraged Sweepers.
While this does not enhance their combat effectiveness, it does make them seem cooler than the originals.
"Here we go! There's an easy prey with pink hair over there!"
"Yo! Switch to the background music we always use for robberies!"
20020.card_quote: —a Hollow Thug urgently debugging an Enraged Sweeper in a Hollow
20020.skill_text: During combat, Illegal Support Unit - Enraged Sweeper uses its long arms to perform a spinning attack. Use Defensive Assist before it does so to completely prevent it from even launching.

20023.card_text:
Mors was once the most feared bounty hunter in the Outer Ring. He possessed an almost obsessive desire to hunt, often tracking his targets relentlessly day in and day out. Once he had a target in his sights, he would obsessively pursue the kill until his prey was dead.

"Lone Wolf Mors" never fails — this is the belief held by all major factions in the Outer Ring.

However, during one "hunt," Mors pursued his target day and night for three days... Yet, even after exhausting his strength, he still failed to kill the target.
Surprisingly, the man named Pompey didn't take it personally and instead offered an invitation to the defeated Mors — asking him to join his own organization.

From that point on, the infamous "hunter" Mors was nowhere to be found. However, within The Vanquishers, a new figure emerged — a silent, solitary captain.
Even now, Mors remains elusive, often disappearing for long periods. He only resurfaces when faced with a foe who genuinely intrigues him, not out of duty as a captain, but simply to indulge in the thrill of combat and the sheer joy of the hunt.
"You want to challenge Captain Mors to a duel? Heh, do you really think you're up for it?"
"Go sign up over there first, then come back next month to try your luck in the draw."
20023.card_quote: — In The Vanquishers, Mors' men fending off the enemy
20023.skill_text: During combat, Mors adapts to the battlefield, switching between close-range combos and long-distance shots. When his health drops below a certain percentage or after a set period, he'll start using follow-up long-range attacks or ambush targets with blind spot shots after quickly repositioning.

20024.card_text:
No one knows where Pulchra came from, but she was once one of the top mercenaries of the Outer Ring, a "chameleon" who was adept at adapting depending on the situation.
Not long after the previous Tour de Inferno ended with Pompey's consecutive victory, a few factions conspired in the shadows to launch a surprise attack on The Vanquishers. This scheme was easily dealt with by The Vanquishers, as if all their plans were within The Vanquishers' grasp.
The losers were chased out of the Old Oil Field, yet Pulchra, who had allied with them, was completely untouched. Naturally, many believed that this victory relied on a betrayal.
Though many made offers, hoping she'd join them, Pulchra never officially joined any gang.
Perhaps, to her, all these conspiracies and conflicts within the Outer Ring were just a game she could quit at any time. Even if her employer was loathsome, she wouldn't care, so long as they had the money and the job was interesting.
Especially if the job involved luring an enemy into an exquisitely prepared trap, allowing her to watch them slowly descend into the abyss of death...
Luring, deceiving into complete destruction... The more beautiful, the more deadly, that has always been her code of survival.
"What, you wanna work under big sis Pulchra?"
"Heh, another poor sucker..."
20024.card_quote: — Within The Vanquishers' camp, a rookie is being teased by a more senior member
20024.skill_text: During combat, Pulchra maintains distance, waiting for the right moment to use physical attacks, her bladeguns, and gadgets to disrupt the target. When her health drops below a certain percentage, she drinks a tonic to enhance her ability to dodge, allowing her to dodge all attacks from nearby targets.

20025.card_text:
As an arena champion with an impressive win streak, Bellum once called himself the number-one fighter in the Outer Ring... Until his win streak was ended.
What was even more infuriating... was that arrogant guy didn't even remember his name.
Angry, Bellum honed his fighting skills, swearing that he would make his name known throughout the Outer Ring once more and make the arrogant jerk who beat him pay.
To achieve his goal, Bellum joined The Vanquishers and helped Pompey defeat enemy after dangerous enemy. He could skillfully modify and operate a flamethrower, leading the charge to incinerate enemies in his path. He could also command his squad with seamless precision, organizing them into an unstoppable battle force. Every battle he led ended in victory.
Now, Bellum no longer needs to make a name for himself.
Though he's no longer that champion with an impressive win streak, in the Outer Ring, everyone knows the terror of gang wars, and as a member of The Vanquishers' core fighting force, Bellum was war itself.
"You don't wanna do menial jobs? Heh, you can complain about that once you defeat boss Bellum!"
"Now go clean the toilet!"
20025.card_quote: — Within The Vanquishers' camp, a veteran scolding a slacking rookie
20025.skill_text: During combat, Bellum uses his bladegun, shield, and flamethrower to pressure the enemy at close range. If Bellum is attacked while guarding with his shield, he'll respond with a powerful counterstrike. When his health drops below a certain percentage, Bellum's attacks intensify, becoming even more vicious and relentless.

30019.card_text:
The Hollow Thugs inside Hollows consist of people of different types who come together for one common goal: raiding the Ether resources in the Hollow for massive profit.
This ragtag bunch have no rules.
However, when the Rampant Brute, a symbol of absolute violence, appears, rules soon follow.
They wear modified construction power systems and use materials lying around as makeshift weapons. These devices and weapons look heavy enough to crush a bodybuilder, but for them, it's the perfect size to wear as a workout outfit.
Swing, shatter, crush... all these basic combat techniques of theirs are fatal strikes that can obliterate their enemies, a showcase of their unparalleled destructive power.
According to Public Security's research, Hollow Thug gangs led by Rampant Brutes often develop strange street workout cultures and are more tight-knit...
"What? You're saying the trainers at the gym are really strong?"
"Hahaha, you need to have your eyes checked!"
"You should join us. Train with the boss for three weeks, and I guarantee you'll have perfect biceps!"
30019.card_quote: — Somewhere in New Eridu, some Hollow Thugs are trying to convince people to join them
30019.skill_text: During combat, Hollow Thug - Rampant Brute charges up his armor with electricity to release a high-level attack. During this time, he enters a Shocked state where his charging is interrupted and he's instantly inflicted with Disorder if any other type of Attribute Anomaly is inflicted.

30027.card_text:
There are quite a few self-proclaimed "master inventors" among Hollow Raiders. Their most proficient skill is taking proper second-hand industrial materials and transforming the abandoned combat machines left by Public Security in the Hollow into not-so-proper personal creations.
High-speed chainsaws, toothed circular saws, hydraulic industrial arms... After simple assembly and rough welding, these common materials are stacked together to form a rare and dangerous piece of machinery.
To make it run smoothly, the creator has "thoughtfully" removed the safety restrictions of the machine and, based on its rugged appearance, named it the Lumberjack.
No one knows how long the Lumberjack can run stably.
Perhaps, at any moment, it could suddenly go berserk, swinging its high-speed rotating chainsaw and spikes with unmatched horsepower, launching an unstoppable logging fest that no one dares to stop.
But... this near-mad combat mode might just be the best modification outcome the creator had in mind.
"Why call it a 'Lumberjack'? There's no wood to chop in the Hollow, right?"
"Yeah, that's why it's so angry. When it starts up, it's reckless..."
30027.card_quote: — In the Hollow, a few Hollow Raiders are discussing the operating principles of the Lumberjack.
30027.skill_text: In combat, the Lumberjack constantly shifts its chainsaw's form to perform fluid combos, using its mounted wheels for swift movement. When enemies are out of reach, it fires saw blades to chase them down from a distance.

100151.card_text:
Among the ranks of Ether thieves, Raiders and Looters serve as the core members, possessing both technical expertise and combat skills.
Their Electric Resonance Detection Devices emit powerful currents that are used to detect Ether ore and also function as formidable weapons during armed raids.
Occasionally mistaken for illegal fishermen, they pay little attention to such misconceptions.
After all, with their extremely lethal electro-shockers, they don't really care whether their targets are fish or humans...
"If you encounter individuals armed with electrified harpoons, whether near a river, lake, or Hollow, please report it immediately to Public Security!"
100151.card_quote: —New Eridu Public Security slogan played repeatedly through promotional cars
100151.skill_text: During combat, Hollow Thug - Looter will charge from a long distance, potentially colliding with obstacles along the way — creating the perfect opportunity to counterattack.

100161.card_text:
For Pyromaniacs and Arsonists, robbing passersby is merely a side hustle. Deep down, they consider themselves as adept bartenders who actively seek excitement.
With precision and skill, they expertly blend various types of Ether into their beverages, effortlessly concocting bottles of highly flammable and explosive "exclusive brew."
Unlike other brutal Hollow Raiders, they often offer their victims a choice.
If the victim agrees to pay the toll, they extend the courtesy of a free drink.
However, if the victim declines, the flammable "exclusive brew" will be forcefully shattered upon their head.
"How about we trick those guys into drinking their own weapon stash?"
100161.card_quote: —Inside the Hollow, robbed investigator quietly discussing strategies for retreating
100161.skill_text: During combat, Hollow Thug - Arsonist will sometimes bombard using a hail of molotov cocktails.

100181.card_text:
Most of the thugs who spend their time in the Hollows exhibit serious mental problems or peculiar quirks. Fortunately, the Poachers and the Rustlers within the gang have managed to maintain their sanity while embracing the filthy methods of traditional villains.
Cowardly and cunning, they excel in the art of concealing themselves within the shadows and launching surprise attacks on their targets. They would never choose to attack head-on if they could ambush.
Their composite hand crossbows, though limited in power, produce minimal noise when fired. Seasoned Poachers often seize the perfect moment and immobilize their unsuspecting prey with a single well-aimed shot.
"I used to be a Public Security officer, then I took an arrow in the knee while on a Hollow operation..."
100181.card_quote: —A senior member of the Nightingale Security Company talking to a rookie
100181.skill_text: During combat, Hollow Thug - Rustler tends to harass targets at a distance using 3-shot bursts.

100191.card_text:
As the vanguards in Hollow Raider gangs, Assaulters and Ambushers often brandish their weapons and charge ahead independently.
This isn't because of their recklessness or disregard for teamwork, but rather a precautionary measure to prevent accidental harm. The modified transformer coils in their hands release high-voltage currents upon contact, capable of paralyzing or even knocking out an opponent with just a touch.
And in the logistically difficult Hollows, an incapacitated teammate could pose a terrible challenge for an entire squad.
"What's this? Lemme check it out! Oh, it's some electric baton replicaaaa... Aaaaaaaaaaarrghhh..."
100191.card_quote: —Final words of a curious novice investigator before falling to the ground in a Hollow
100191.skill_text: During combat, Hollow Thug - Ambusher launches continual spinning assaults, but this crazy suicidal attack often reveals a weakness after.

200151.card_text:
In contrast to fully equipped Hollow investigators, Bulky Intimidators and Wanted Intimidators possess minimalistic gear.
Nevertheless, these notorious thugs can easily instill fear in their victims with their makeshift equipment.
A spiked metal bat and a modified double-barreled shotgun are all they need to establish themselves as the most feared brutes in the Hollow.
According to investigators who have encountered them in the Hollows, these brutes enter an extreme state of euphoria during battle. Their "demeanor" could hardly be called combat suitable, and more closely resembles bullying.
"Fighting them brought back the fear I felt when facing the school bullies alone..."
200151.card_quote: —Hollow Investigative Association Resignation Letter from a rookie investigator
200151.skill_text: During combat, Hollow Thug - Wanted Intimidator switches between using a club and a shotgun for nearby attacks while sometimes kicking up sand to launch an ambush.

200171.card_text:
There is a consensus within the New Eridu underworld that the most formidable fighters are not the champions of the ring, but rather the Bulky Enforcers and Wanted Enforcers lurking in the depths of the Hollow. These professional thugs are hired by Ether thieves at high prices to protect their illegally excavated Ether resources.
Being ardent boxing enthusiasts, Bulky Enforcers have modified high-voltage stun guns into boxing gloves, augmenting the destructive power of their punches.
To them, Ethereals, Hollow Raiders, Hollow investigators, and even scattered members of Public Security... are not seen as opponents but merely as "training sandbags" for their personal amusement.
"Wait a minute! I think I've seen this guy's fighting stance in the arcade on Fourth Street!"
200171.card_quote: —Billy dealing with a charging thug in a Hollow
200171.skill_text: During combat, Hollow Thug - Wanted Enforcer uses both fists to punch while using nimble sidesteps to shake up the angle of attack.

200172.card_text:
There is a consensus within the New Eridu underworld that the most formidable fighters are not the champions of the ring, but rather the Bulky Enforcers and Wanted Enforcers lurking in the depths of the Hollow. These professional thugs are hired by Ether thieves at high prices to protect their illegally excavated Ether resources.
Being ardent boxing enthusiasts, Bulky Enforcers have modified high-voltage stun guns into boxing gloves, augmenting the destructive power of their punches.
To them, Ethereals, Hollow Raiders, Hollow investigators, and even scattered members of Public Security... are not seen as opponents but merely as "training sandbags" for their personal amusement.
"Wait a minute! I think I've seen this guy's fighting stance in the arcade on Fourth Street!"
200172.card_quote: —Billy dealing with a charging thug in a Hollow
200172.skill_text: During combat, Troublemaker - Wanted Enforcer is extremely aggressive, using nimble sidesteps to shake up the angle of attack.

940002.card_text: The Lumberjack is a highly dangerous enemy. While dealing <color=#D9A600>massive single-target DMG</color>, it also unleashes <color=#D9A600>large AoE DMG</color> around itself. Keep your distance!
940002.skill_text:
HP: Super High
ATK: High
DEF: High
Movement Speed: Medium
Threat Level: <color=#FF3333>Super High</color>

940003.card_text: The Rampant Brute is a highly dangerous enemy. He can deal <color=#D9A600>massive DMG</color> to targets, so when using Paperboo to block him, be sure to deploy Kind Bangboo strategically to ensure <color=#D9A600>Paperboo's</color> safety!
940003.skill_text:
HP: Super High
ATK: Super High
DEF: High
Movement Speed: Medium
Threat Level: <color=#FF3333>Super High</color>

10017.card_text:
A fallen creation, reshaped in deep, tainted darkness.
The Miasma Blastcrawler wears crimson red, yet still can't shake off its "low threat" stigma, as its movement speed and blast radius remain— unchanged...
However, the Association has repeatedly issued warnings, urging investigators to guard against the miasma smoke released after its explosion. If inhaled carelessly, a moment of disorientation is enough for even an Elite Investigator to perish in the ever-changing Hollows.
"Red team is ready! Here comes the green team walking towards us..."
10017.card_quote: —While collecting ghost stories, Lucia is making Blastcrawlers fight like crickets
10017.skill_text: After being corrupted by Miasma, Miasmic - Blastcrawler becomes extremely unstable, leaving behind Miasma residue that can trigger another explosion after it self-detonates. A well-timed Defensive Assist against its leap can redirect the blast in your favor.

10033.card_text:
An Ethereal Soldier formed from Miasma, wielding a massive, corruptive Miasma blade and protected by an almost impenetrable defense shield, instinctively covers other Miasmic Troopers as they advance.
Their immense physical mass and extensive defensive reach make them formidable in positional warfare, especially in groups, where they become significantly harder to handle. The Hollow Investigative Association advises swiftly eliminating any isolated units on sight.
"An Ethereal whose main role is to protect others? Now that's a rare sight..."
"Don't overestimate the Ethereals. Remember, whatever's behind these things was never human to begin with!"
10033.card_quote: —Two Hollow Investigators exchanging intel on the sly.
10033.skill_text: During combat, Miasmic Trooper - Shieldguard uses its shield to both significantly reduce DMG and Daze taken, and also counterattack.

10034.card_text:
The Ethereal soldiers, formed from Miasma, wear tattered old uniforms and linger in the smoke of battle like ghosts from another era.
Hollow observation data shows that the Canonneers can strike nearby targets with impressive precision using their bazookas — a level of accuracy suggesting rigorous training, which has sparked much speculation.
"Could these newly discovered, highly organized Ethereal units be linked to the Defense Force?"
"Sorry. No comment until the matter is fully investigated and confirmed."
10034.card_quote: —Official response from a Defense Force spokesperson.
10034.skill_text: In combat, the Miasmic Trooper - Cannoneer prefers to provide heavy firepower support from a distance. Additionally, some of its skills inflict potent Miasma Corruption.

20011.card_text:
A fallen creation, reshaped in the depths of impure darkness.
To step into the domain of the sleeping behemoth is to prepare for confronting the crimson nightmare, for it's no longer content with games of hide and seek.
The reckless Hollow Raider attempts to provoke, luring it to expose its deeply buried core. Yet skilled hunters often appear as prey - letting your guard down when the enemy's weakness is revealed is often a rookie's deadliest flaw.
"Don't call me stupid, my head really was caught in those Ethereal pincers..."
20011.card_quote: —A grumbling Trainee Investigator getting scolded by their senior
20011.skill_text: During combat, Miasma Ravager - Huskron, corrupted by Miasma, now possesses enhanced physique and a more vicious assault pattern. Using a Defensive Assist at the right moment can counter its brutal offense.

20016.card_text:
Once a standard fire-support mech, now corrupted within the Hollow. It's tactical algorithms now in total disarray, flagging every lifeform it sees as a high-threat target and firing indiscriminately.
Built for offense over defense, it boasts exceptional mobility, making it hard to hit and relentless in pursuit.
If you're unlucky enough to be tagged by it, pray there's a spatial rift nearby — without one, escape is nearly impossible.
"If I could go back to middle school, I'd never slack off in track practice again."
20016.card_quote: —From the diary of a shaken Hollow Raider, written with trembling hands
20016.skill_text: In combat, Miasmic - Lightfoot Rover summons two drones to assist in battle. If Miasmic - Heavy Striker is also on the field, Miasmic - Lightfoot Rover will coordinate attacks together with it. Additionally, when Miasmic - Heavy Striker is close to death, Miasmic - Lightfoot Rover will leap toward the target due to coordinated combat signal interference, seize its combat data core, gain part of Miasmic - Heavy Striker's shield components and abilities, and trigger a small Miasmic Field.

20018.card_text:
This autonomous tactical mech, swallowed by the Hollow, has grown even more brutal after corruption, powerful enough to crush Goblins with ease.
Once a steadfast shield protecting soldiers against devastating attacks, the Defense Force's most trusted companion has now transformed into a terrifying killing machine.
"If you have the courage, then grant our once-reliable friend a final end, freeing it from the sins and shattered honor it now carries."
20018.card_quote: —Words from a graying combat mechanic, left upon retirement
20018.skill_text: In combat, when Miasmic - Heavy Striker deploys its shield, it activates a small Miasmic Field. If Miasmic - Lightfoot Rover is also on the field, the two will carry out coordinated attacks. Additionally, when Miasmic - Lightfoot Rover is close to death, Miasmic - Heavy Striker will leap toward the target due to coordinated combat signal interference, seize its combat data core, acquire Miasmic - Lightfoot Rover's drones and abilities, and command the drones to fight alongside it.

20026.card_text:
A fallen creation, reshaped in profound darkness and impurity.

Unfortunate souls mutated by the intense corruption of Etheric matter within the Hollows. Due to a considerable degree of Ether aptitude and physical capability, their bodies have not been completely transformed by the Ether, retaining humanoid features but with enhanced mutant limbs that are more dangerous.

Judging from the remnants of clothing and combat experience, likely once a senior gang member or Raider lurking in the Hollows.

These corrupted subjects, potentially due to their enhanced physiology or affinity for Ether matter, have developed formidable close combat abilities, making them even more menacing than the typical monsters found in the Hollow.

"Their weapons look very fancy... and kinda like they came as freebies."
20026.card_quote: —Anby's analysis of a particular operation with the Cunning Hares
20026.skill_text: In combat, the Miasmic - Frenzied Maniac uses its stealth specialty to launch surprise attacks. When paired with Miasmic - Trinox, it will perform a Perfect Dodge against player attacks, followed by a Coordinated Attack with Miasmic - Trinox. Additionally, when one of them dies, the survivor will enter Frenzy.

20027.card_text:
A fallen creation, reshaped in profound darkness and impurity.

The Hollow Investigative Association has been studying the mutation characteristics of Ethereal humanoid bodies.

Trinox has consistently ranked in the top three of research popularity lists due to its seemingly deliberately designed triangular head structure. There were even rumors of mathematicians disguising themselves as investigators to infiltrate the Hollow just to witness Trinox firsthand.

The latest research results were published in "Hollow Encyclopedia" Issue 28, February Edition. According to subscribers, the article only discussed the aesthetic significance of Trinox's head structure.

Dissatisfied Hollow-related readers gave the article the lowest score of the issue on the magazine's website, with only a 34% approval rating currently.

"Trinox's head measurements are close to the ancient golden ratio!"

"We're fighting the Ethereal, not hosting a beauty pageant for them, Professor."
20027.card_quote: —From "The Durham Show" Episode 79, a conversation between host Durham and mathematician Isaac, who was left with a limp after entering the Hollow
20027.skill_text: In combat, Miasmic - Trinox uses parry mechanics to deflect DMG and unleash Block Counter. When Miasmic - Frenzied Maniac is present on the field, Miasmic - Trinox will command it to perform a Coordinated Attack together. Additionally, when one of them dies, the survivor will enter Frenzy.

20031.card_text:
A fallen being, reforged within the depths of corruption and shadow.
Its most striking feature lies in its grotesquely developed arms, the embodiment of the Wicked Wraith's fury. The limbs themselves are bulkier than a standard double-door refrigerator, coated in dense keratin layers that interlock to form a natural hammer shape. One expert from the Hollow Investigative Association claimed such abnormal development may stem from the host's original body having long relied on heavy machinery or strength-enhancing equipment, causing its physical traits to become grotesquely amplified during the corruption process.
Reports indicate it can smash through reinforced concrete and fling the remains of derelict vehicles several dozen meters. Among investigators, it's colloquially known as the "Hollow Demolition Crew."
One account tells of a Wicked Wraith that, in its fury, leveled a whole ruin in under a minute, only to get stuck in a tight corridor, its massive frame unable to keep balance, and was later retrieved as a research specimen.
"When it slams the ground, even the echoes throughout the Hollow tremble... but if you're quick enough, maybe you won't have to arm-wrestle it."
20031.card_quote: —A consistently lucky investigator that believes good fortune comes from waiting patiently.
20031.skill_text: Miasmic - Wicked Wraith attacks with a giant axe and shotgun. Its axe attacks can create Miasma Pools on the ground, and these attacks can inflict an Miasma Corruption effect on players.

30009.card_text:
Belobog's founder, Khors Belobog, once said that construction machines are the combination of strength and beauty, with attention to every detail following the principles of classic mechanical design.
However, the emergence of the Unknown Corruption Complex has challenged all established classic designs.
Driven by an intensely concentrated Ether Core, various formidable engineering components have been brutally assembled, resulting in an exaggerated structure that pushes the limits of physical boundaries.
It incorporates cutting, hammering, drilling, and crushing techniques... transforming them into rough and unpredictable combat maneuvers.
Furthermore, in its critical state, its Ether Core provides an inexhaustible source of volatile energy. This enables it to envelop its carapace with high-voltage currents and unleash devastating blasts capable of ripping through the ground and pulverizing nearby enemies.
According to HIA speculation, the Unknown Corruption Complex is able to devour and assimilate a wide range of heavy machinery, including military mechs, laser weapons, and even the short-range missiles of the Defense Force...
Every intricate mechanical object it encounters is consumed, dissected, and ultimately assimilated into its structure.
Its design objective is to achieve unrivaled destructive power and maximize efficiency in its relentless slaughter.
"Its design far too strange... Oh, alright, I'll just take one more look!"
30009.card_quote: —Grace on observing an Unknown Corruption Complex deep in a Hollow
30009.skill_text: During combat, Unknown Corruption Complex combines attacks from various machinery units, and can release a dense array of missiles. Attack its main body while Stunned until it becomes Impaired, taking significant damage in one shot. If its legs get damaged, it can also become Impaired, building up significant Daze in one shot.

30021.card_text:
People in the Outer Ring once called him the "Overlord Pompey" with true respect.
But now, his soul has been corrupted by potent Ether, his body polluted by sulfur and crude oil; the heart that once beat solely to protect the Outer Ring has turned into a supercritical Ether core filled with infinite power.
The former "Lord of the Outer Ring" has been reborn in flames, taking on a different form.
Freedom, majesty... Violence, insanity.
It charges through the dust and flames, seizing anything that moves and then mercilessly tearing and shattering it.
Those familiar with it before have guessed from its fractured whispers that what drives it is not a desire for petty revenge, but rather a desire to crush all outliers who dare to challenge the laws of the Outer Ring.
Maybe it's the last vestige of the former Overlord Pompey's lingering will.
"Our leader has turned into that thing, but... he still feels like the same person."
30021.card_quote: — A former henchman of The Vanquishers, shaking with fear
30021.skill_text: During combat, overlord Pompey attacks using a combination of a motorcycle and hover guns. However, during certain moves, if countered with a Defensive Assist, his weakness will be exposed. After taking a certain amount of damage, he will enter a second phase. In this phase, he alternates between using the motorcycle's rear wheel and a longsword for attacks. The motorcycle's rear wheel can also accumulate Ether energy, leading to a explosion across a large area.

30034.card_text:
A monster forged from Miasma and the memories of a mystic — every painful, haunting moment now sealed within this chaotic form.
It's nothing but an imitation in the end, never brave enough to rise up, never decisive enough to disappear without a trace. Yet for its creator, this was sufficient — as a mere pawn, those memories steeped in agony served as potent fuel, enough to turn the Hollow upside down and expose all secrets to the world.
Thus, driven by memories not its own, the Miasma that birthed it made it restless, the approaching Ethereals filled it with rage, and even while prowling its own territory, it remained forever uneasy.
Only once, when it chased a human to the edge of the Hollow and saw the fear on their face, was its hunting instinct unexpectedly overridden by a strange impulse. It came to an involuntary stop. And when that unlucky figure vanished from view, it felt something new: an emotion startlingly close to satisfaction.
But that sense of satisfaction didn't last. A group of humans in black armor began intruding into its territory again and again, unfazed by any threat. Agitation and exhaustion slowly wore it down — until all it wanted was for everything that moved to disappear. Disappear! DISAPPEAR!!!
...
"...Let's... settle... this...
Strange, what was that voice?
"It's deeply connected... The one who tied the knot must be the one to untie it!"
Memories long smothered by madness stirred back to life. Yes... yes! That was the sound — the one that had echoed endlessly in its mind. Though instinct screamed for it to attack, its body hesitated. Its gaze followed the glint of silver hair, so much like its own, desperate to see if the voice belonged to the figure that kept resurfacing in its memory.
Distracted, it took a direct hit to its core from behind, the excruciating pain nearly breaking it. Yet it still heard that faint whisper:
"I'm sorry, I must do this..."
Though the words made no sense to it, that near-satisfying emotion returned. It became aware that something genuinely frightening now had it in its grip. It might die because of it... but it had no intention of fleeing.
In the end, its strength was completely spent. But in that final moment, it could finally see her clearly. She wasn't quite the same as in its memories, and that fleeting realization brought a trace of loneliness. But even so, it liked her current self more than the heart-shattering screams of the past.

"The 'Miasmic Fiend'... Hmm, though Ferox's subordinates named it first, this creature's ghostly and vicious nature certainly lives up to the name. We plan to register it as such — what does you think, Yixuan Shifu?"
"Have you heard the ancient saying? 'A name makes the truth no less unfathomable.' A name is just a name — whatever rolls off the tongue will do."
30034.card_quote: —A conversation between an investigator naming the Miasmic Fiend and Yixuan
30034.skill_text: During combat, Miasmic Fiend - Unfathomable will enhance its weapon and unleash powerful attacks that cannot be blocked. Additionally, Miasmic Fiend - Unfathomable will leap to a high point to activate a Miasmic Field and consume Miasmic Shield to launch multiple waves of attacks. Draw its attacks to detonate the Miasma Pool to prevent it from absorbing the Miasma Pool and restoring its Miasmic Shield, and quickly move away when it jumps back into the battlefield to avoid being caught in its deadly finishing attack.

30036.card_text:
A fallen creation, reforged in the depths of filth and darkness.
A veteran model of countless battles, the Terror Raptors are New Eridu's most trusted weapon of war. Designed for a perfect balance of brutal melee and devastating ranged firepower, it delivers destruction with every charge and strike. Armed with multi-missile launchers and rapid-fire guns, it dominates both close-quarters and distant combat. From leaping assaults to explosive barrages and swift aerial retreats, the Raptor adapts to any battlefield with ease. Its relentless attacks leave enemies no room to fight back, embodying both unstoppable power and overwhelming fear.

"Terror Raptor was the symbol of that era."
30036.card_quote: — As written in "The Battle of the Old Capital: Truth and Memories"
30036.skill_text:
In combat, the Miasmic Terror Raptor suppresses enemies with various ranged weapons, while its six stealth drones provide additional firepower at staggered intervals.
When it fires special Miasma shells, you can use Defensive Assist to counter and reflect them, temporarily paralyzing the Miasmic Terror Raptor. At specific points in battle, it also activates the Miasmic Field, shifting to primarily melee attacks while its six drones blink and execute strike patterns at regular intervals. Beware: many of the Terror Raptor's abilities and drone attacks inflict potent Miasma Corruption.

30039.card_text:
A gaunt and eerie skeleton, bearing a pale, sharp "Cape"—another masterpiece from the Exaltists. When it comes to "100 Ways to Integrate Humans into Hollows," their experimental enthusiasm is truly unmatched.
Those who've encountered Haytor believe these folks must be high-ranking Exaltist members; after all, even as Ethereals, they still couldn't resist creating some lackeys to boss around.

"I absolutely hate people like that!"

"I bet they even say to their phantoms... 'I'm rather disappointed in you, as you could have done better; when I summoned you, I actually had higher expectations'?!"
30039.card_quote: —On a typical late-night overtime shift, an enraged HSO officer violently bangs on Haytor's frame while shouting
30039.skill_text: In combat, Haytor uses Phantoms to deceive opponents and launch surprise attacks; after entering Miasmic Field, Haytor can summon even larger Phantoms to attack alongside him. During this time, successfully parrying the large Phantoms' attacks will weaken the Miasmic Shield.

30041.card_text:
A Corrupted with rich combat experience, equally skilled in offense and defense, moving with agility. It excels at lurking in hidden spots, launching the most efficient attacks targeting weak points.

I should have recorded more - its behavioral patterns, the haunting song that follows it like a shadow, things like that... But let's leave it at that, just like the half-finished portrait in Lucia's book.

"One little star, up high. Two little stars, float by. Three little stars, it's time to go and hide."
30041.card_quote: —The investigators, "tormented" by the simulation data of the Wandering Hunter, found themselves unconsciously humming nursery rhymes while doing household chores
30041.skill_text: In combat, the Wandering Hunter possesses extremely high DEF. Some of its ranged skills can generate Miasma Pool on the ground, while most skills can trigger Miasma Pool to create Stray Blades for disruptive shots. Additionally, when the Wandering Hunter activates Miasmic Field, it conceals itself and charges strength. When players use Perception Technique to break through Drowned Ideal - Lucia, the Wandering Hunter will reveal itself and launch an ambush. A successful Defensive Assist can interrupt its action, causing Impaired status and reducing its Miasmic Shield. If you fail to correctly identify Drowned Ideal: Lucia, or after a period of time, the Wandering Hunter will unleash a powerful skill that ignores the Invulnerable effect to deal DMG, maxing out the team's Miasma Contamination value.

100271.card_text:
A poor soul mutated by the corruption due to potent Ether matter in the Hollows. As the original entity had a certain level of Ether aptitude, the transformation is not fully complete, retaining some humanoid features of the original form. Judging by the remnants of clothing and combat experience, it's quite likely it was originally a thug/criminal dwelling within the Hollow.
While gangsters and thugs in the Hollows typically wear anti-corruption gear, some unlucky individuals undergo monstrous transformations due to severe Ether corruption. These transformed Ethereal beings retain their combat skills from their past lives, making them a more formidable threat compared to pure Ethereals.
"They lived as criminals, and even in death they continue being a nuisance."
100271.card_quote: —A New Eridu Public Security discussion post on the Planet of Disaster forum
100271.skill_text: During combat, Corrupted Bandit - Vicious Striker performs a flurry of slashes that is difficult to interrupt.

100281.card_text:
This humanoid intelligent being is a result of potent Ether matter corruption in the Hollow, exhibiting both humanoid traits and remnants of its former clothing and combat style. It is likely that it was once a gang member or raider living in the Hollow.
The creature's physical characteristics indicate its past as a long-range weapon specialist. Despite losing its free will and life due to Etherealization, it retains its instincts and habits for long-range combat. Its corrupted form enables it to launch projectiles, attacking enemies from a distance. The Ether corruption has enhanced its shooting abilities and projectile firepower. (For example, these creatures may fire sharp Ether Crystals or mixed explosives.)
"I told him not to touch that crystal, but he wouldn't listen! That reckless idiot never listens! By the time we were about to leave the Hollow, he... he changed..."
100281.card_quote: —Faunus Quarter Public Security Office Branch, Record of an Interrogation
100281.skill_text: During combat, Corrupted Bandit: Greedy Ranger launches ranged attacks that are difficult to detect.

200121.card_text:
Unfortunate souls mutated by the intense corruption of Ether matter within the Hollows. Due to a considerable degree of Ether aptitude and physical capability, their bodies have not been completely transformed by the Ether, retaining humanoid features but with enhanced mutant limbs that are more dangerous.
Judging from the remnants of clothing and its combat experience, it was likely once a senior gang member or Raider lurking in the Hollows.
These corrupted subjects, potentially due to their enhanced physiology or affinity for Ether matter, have developed formidable close combat abilities, making them even more menacing than the typical monsters found in the Hollow.
"Their weapons look very fancy... and kinda like they came as freebies."
200121.card_quote: —Anby's analysis of a particular operation with the Cunning Hares
200121.skill_text: During combat, Corrupted Bandit: Frenzied Maniac blocks attacks and launches a counter after blocking for a while.

Bandits are notorious for their dangerous behavior, and within their ranks, Hollow bandits stand out as the most ruthless. The elite fighters among these Hollow bandits are especially terrifying, displaying an elevated level of violence. When these brutes, toughened both physically and mentally through violence, undergo Ether corruption, they transform into monsters with a more feral and savage nature.
"They used to yell 'money or your life,' but now they're just hell-bent on taking your life..."
200141.card_quote: —Annotations in the internal textbook of the Hollow Investigative Association, "Threat Identification in a Hollow: Corrupted Subjects"
200141.skill_text: During combat, Corrupted Bandit: Ruthless Fiend launches continual attacks on targets nearby, and charges at faraway targets. It becomes more ferocious once its arms become destroyed.

300211.card_text:
People in the Outer Ring once called him the "Overlord Pompey" with true respect.
But now, his soul has been corrupted by potent Ether, his body polluted by sulfur and crude oil; the heart that once beat solely to protect the Outer Ring has turned into a supercritical Ether core filled with infinite power.
The former "Lord of the Outer Ring" has been reborn in flames, taking on a different form.
Freedom, majesty... Violence, insanity.
It charges through the dust and flames, seizing anything that moves and then mercilessly tearing and shattering it.
Those familiar with it before have guessed from its fractured whispers that what drives it is not a desire for petty revenge, but rather a desire to crush all outliers who dare to challenge the laws of the Outer Ring.
Maybe it's the last vestige of the former Overlord Pompey's lingering will.
"Our leader has turned into that thing, but... he still feels like the same person."
300211.card_quote: — A former henchman of The Vanquishers, shaking with fear
300211.skill_text: In combat, Notorious Pompey's attacks leave unstable Ether energy on the ground. When enemies approach, or he launches a Charged Attack, the Ether energy explodes violently. When necessary, he raises his weapon to block. Upon a successful block, he immediately counterattacks the enemy.

A high-ranking priest of the Exaltists who holds the position of "Flame Cantor," and who has the power to manipulate Miasma. This defiling force drains life, while the flames light the path ahead.

While all Exaltist fanatics tend to either shout or chant vague slogans like "Refinement" and "Creator" when attacking you, few can make known the experience of true "Refinement" using Miasmic fire like this one does.

"They just charge at you, screaming things like 'Refinement,' 'Creator,' 'Purification' and whatnot!"

930174.card_text:
An unsettling chant often echoed through the Hollow. The veteran miners strictly forbade anyone from approaching its source, but newcomer Johnny brushed off their warnings. Spurred on by a foolish bet, he crept step by step toward the source of the sound. Finally, he reached a clearing. There, a group of people wearing identical uniforms and eerie masks stood in a circle, performing some mysterious ritual. All around them, a group of Ethereals slowly closed in. Johnny shouted warnings, hoping they would flee, but they remained deaf to his cries. Instead, the Ethereals, drawn by Johnny's voice, lunged at him...

"We will do all we can to enhance discipline amongst the miners. God keep Johnny's soul."
930174.card_quote: — Veteran miner Sally, interview with the New Metro Daily following Johnny's disappearance
930174.skill_text: In combat, when threatened, the Exalting Hymnist will trigger a powerful explosion that affects both friend and foe.

20006.card_text:
An automatic combat mech utilized by Public Security. It possesses various combat modes tailored to various Ethereals types. Its weapons include circular chainsaws and fusion heat rays.
Sweepers can swiftly identify target Ethereals and adapt to the most effective combat strategy.
However, their reliability diminishes to some extent when faced with Hollow Raiders who possess greater versatility than Ethereals.
"Stirring, chopping, heating... I wonder who came up with this? Maybe some undercover agent from a kitchenware company trying to boost sales?"
20006.skill_text: During combat, Autonomous Support Unit - Sweeper uses its long arms to perform a spinning attack. Use Defensive Assist before it does so to completely prevent it from even executing the skill.

10005.card_text:
A light infantry unit of the New Eridu Defense Force.
Armed with combat knives and small Ether explosives as their primary weapons, they emphasize mobility and stealth. Often deployed as scouts or members of reconnaissance teams, they rely on exceptional maneuverability for tasks such as surprise attacks, scouting, pursuit, and assassination.
In Hollow-related operations, they serve as excellent vanguards, using their close combat skills to easily overpower ordinary invaders or lower-level living Ether beings.
"Masters of the dagger? More like crafty grenadiers. Pretending to be all fancy with their daggers, when most of their opponents are clearly taken out by grenades!"
10005.skill_text: During combat, Strike Jaeger slides to get close to targets or tosses out knives with delayed explosions.

10006.card_text:
As the New Eridu Defense Force's signature combat unit, qualified Light Jaegers and Scout Jaegers can freely switch between various combat modes.
Whether using a knife in close combat or the Falcon-MK3 Ether energy gun at long range, they can tailor their tactics to the target's weaknesses.
And when their opponent is in disarray they launch an offensive without hesitation.
"I saw that guy with a knife and was preparing for a fair fight... I didn't expect him to suddenly pull out a gun."
10006.card_quote: —Inter-Knot forum, comment from a rookie Hollow Raider
10006.skill_text: During combat, Light Jaeger will provide continual fire support.

10007.card_text:
Rookie Jaegers and Private Jaegers play a crucial role as vanguards in the Defense Force's Hollow special operations.
Equipped with the Coyote-PE7 Ether cutter, which boasts a high-frequency vibration cutting blade effective at deterring smaller enemies.
Engaging Ethereals in close-quarters combat demands exceptional courage, or perhaps madness.
"Strictly speaking, that can't be considered a standardized anti-Hollow operation... Those lunatics just seem to enjoy brawling with Ethereals for fun."
10007.card_quote: —Defense Force Patrol Department, Frontline Operation Report
10007.skill_text: During combat, Rookie Jaeger performs melee attacks.

10008.card_text:
As a vital offensive and defensive unit in the Defense Force's tactical squads, Guard Jaegers and Patrol Jaegers not only carry "Coyote-PE7" heavy Ether cutters but also inert Ether blast shields, providing cover for tactical squads in complex battlefield environments.
As a high-defense unit, the extraordinary weight of the shield affects their combat mobility.
Without strict training, an ordinary person would find it challenging to lift such a shield.
"Come back and submit your application once you've hit the gym!"
10008.card_quote: —A refusal letter received by a certain applicant at the Defense Force Recruitment Center
10008.skill_text: During combat, Guard Jaeger uses its shield to both significantly reduce DMG and Daze taken, and also counterattack.

10009.card_text:
Grenadier Jaegers and Demolition Jaegers are equipped with a modified version of the Mamba-TG3 Bazooka, featuring special ammunition containing active Ether incendiary agents. This weapon enables them to swiftly destroy enemy mech units and eliminate large Ethereals within the Hollows.
To counteract the recoil and ensure accurate aim, they are required to undergo special weapon-grip training. Interestingly, Defense Force statistics indicate recruits excelling in this program often possess prior experience in photography.
"Wanna know how to use this thing? It's like using a shoulder-mounted camera."
"Just lock onto your target, pull the trigger, and say..."
"Hey, idiot!... Say cheese!"
10009.card_quote: —New recruits training camp instructor explaining how to use the rockets
10009.skill_text: During combat, Grenadier Jaeger provides heavy ranged fire support.

20007.card_text:
An automatic tactical mech of the Defense Force, providing continuous fire support for front-line personnel.
Its inert Ether shield can withstand most light firepower and even impacts from large-sized Ethereals.
Undoubtedly, it is one of the most trusted "companions" of the Defense Force.
"Remember, if you're in trouble, just stay behind them... You'll be pretty safe unless they accidentally squish you."
20007.card_quote: — From a lecturer sharing their experience during the Defense Force recruit training
20007.skill_text: During combat, Heavy Striker deploys a shield. While shielded, it will only accumulate Fire and Physical Anomaly Buildup. Inflict Burn, Assault, or Stun it to break the shield.

20008.card_text:
The Lightfoot Rover, a mainstream fire-support mech in the Defense Force, is equipped with tactical algorithms that analyze the opponent's behavior and calculate trajectories for precise targeting.
When it identifies a high-threat target, it deploys a swarm of drones from its arsenal, unleashing immense firepower.
For Hollow Raiders, the sudden appearance of a Lightfoot Rover can spell trouble... endless trouble...
"What the! It... it even has kids!?"
20008.card_quote: — A novice Hollow Raider being pursued in the depths of Papago Hollow
20008.skill_text: During combat, Lightfoot Rover summons two drones to fight in tandem, which can be piloted nearby a target to launch a self-destruct attack.

20009.card_text:
A heavy infantry unit belonging to the New Eridu Defense Force.
Equipped with "Gray Rhino" heavy combat armor paired with a complete arsenal enhanced using Ether technology, they can sustain high-intensity firepower for an extended period when ample ammunition is available. They serve as the assault core of a combat team and are often deployed as the front line in assault and clearance operations.
After the fall of the old capital, many soldiers left the army and joined civilian factions. Since then, these elite gunners have emerged under various banners, including private armies of plutocrats, new security companies, and even roving gangs of bandits...
"I'm convinced those heavy gunners are secretly adorable little girls who somehow manage to hide all that ammo in the extra pockets of their combat suits. I mean, how else can you explain their endless stockpile of shells?"
20009.card_quote: —Comment on the Daydream page of the Planet of Disaster forum
20009.skill_text: During combat, Heavy Gunner switches between using laser cannons and frag grenades to perform continual long-range attacks.

30002.card_text:
The Defense Force will only dispatch the fully armed mechs known as Guardians during operations in large-scale Hollows.
These mechs are equipped with active Ether shock blasters, Ether-charging guns MARS-74, and even fusion heat rays... causing the Guardian to often be referred to as Public Security's mobile arsenal.
Despite their formidable firepower, they possess impressive mobility, enabling them to jump and sprint while dispersing groups of lesser Ethereals and advancing the front lines.
For Hollow Raiders, encountering a single Guardian is akin to facing an impregnable fortress.
"I'll strike in my Fortress Form!"
30002.card_quote: —Lines from the New Eridu popcorn movie "Frontline Guardians, Transform!"
30002.skill_text: During combat, Autonomous Support Unit - Guardian not only performs powerful melee attacks, but can also use a variety of ranged attacks. When adjacent to another unit, some Autonomous Support Unit - Guardian units will focus on providing ranged fire support from outside the core battlefield.

30008.card_text:
As a heavy mech, the Typhon Challenger is devoid of any added long-range firepower; instead, its focus is on its Ether-Kinetic Armor.
Impact attacks, heavy blows, crushing... The Typhon Challenger employs simple yet efficient tactical maneuvers to maximize the destructive power afforded to it by its Ether-Kinetic Armor. The shockwave effects from its strikes can even intimidate larger Ethereals...
Even the most seasoned Hollow Raiders can only let out a sigh of helplessness when confronted with the impenetrable Typhon Challenger.
"The tall and robust physique, powerful and sturdy arms... It's my ideal type... I mean, ideal model."
30008.card_quote: —Grace playing with a model of Typhon Challenger at the gadget store
30008.skill_text: During combat, Autonomous Tactical Unit - Typhon Challenger performs powerful combos and sometimes also leaps into the air to launch a clobbering blow.

30026.card_text:
A veteran of countless battles, the Terror Raptor is New Eridu's most trusted weapon of war. Designed for a perfect balance of brutal melee and devastating ranged firepower, it delivers destruction with every charge, stomp, and strike. Armed with multi-missile launchers and rapid-fire guns, it dominates both close and distant combat. From leaping assaults to explosive barrages and swift aerial retreats, the Raptor adapts to any battlefield with ease. Its relentless attacks leave enemies no room to fight back, embodying both unstoppable power and overwhelming fear.
"Terror Raptor was the symbol of that era."
30026.card_quote: — As written in "The Battle of the Old Capital: Truth and Memories"
